jobs.description:
Located within CSLB’s GSPV department, the Director, Global Safety Lead, Formulation Safety provide expertise on all aspects of –clinical safety throughout the entire lifecycle of a product with special emphasis on ongoing evaluation of safety information during clinical development and post approval. (S)He will apply sound medical judgment for analysis and interpretation of complex clinical safety data for signal detection and initiation of safety risk management activities including safety specification, PV planning and risk minimization/mitigation. Integrate safety risk management activities of the product into their medical, business, and regulatory context.

The role serves as the safety representative in the cross-functional development teams and post-marketing product teams. It is responsible for setting safety strategy for these global projects. Strong product knowledge is needed for success in the role.

The role ensures that the medical and process standards delivered in CSLB are in alignment with the following safety objectives expected of manufacturers by internal and external stakeholders including regulators, governmental agencies, payors, physicians, patients and the general public:

• Complying with legal requirements and company standards of the PV (Pharmacovigilance) tasks and responsibilities.

• Preventing harm from adverse reactions in humans arising from the use of authorized medicinal products within or outside the terms of the market authorization or from occupational exposure.

• Promoting the safe and effective use of medicinal products in particular through providing timely information about the safety of medicinal products to patients, healthcare professionals and the public.

• Contributing to the protection of patients and public health.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Safety Surveillance and Risk Management: Oversees safety management teams ensuring a thorough and consistent approach to the review of safety data emerging from clinical trials and from the post-marketing environment. Oversees the safety signal detection and medical signal evaluation process. Oversees analysis of aggregate safety data and the production of key company documents such as DSURs (Development Safety Update Reports), PSURs (Periodic Safety Update Reports) and risk management plans relating to the safety of medicinal products, which are subject to regulatory review and discussion.

• Quality Management: Ensures timely production of aggregate reports and answers to queries from Health Authorities according to consistent quality standards.

• Regulatory Agency Requests: Responsible for timely and concise responses to Regulatory Agency requests relating to patient safety.

• Inspections: Ensures regulatory agency inspection findings and internal audit findings relating to products of responsibility are addressed and resultant Corrective Action Plans (CAPA plans) are implemented efficiently and effectively in the function.

• Clinical Safety Development of the CSLB portfolio: Oversees all processes that lead to the production of safety sections and content of relevant clinical trial documents including protocols, investigator brochures, informed consent forms, clinical study reports. Oversees development of core safety information for new products. Sets the strategy, reviews and approves key filing documents including Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS), Summary of Clinical safety (SCS), and risk management plans (RMPs). Provides major contributions to current and potential safety issues, being proactive in addressing safety issues and setting up any additional systems to mitigate risk in CSLB’s studies. Gives guidance on various medical, product-related and process-related matters in a complex medical and scientific environment including many interface departments and functions.

• Clinical Safety Representation: Chairs the Safety Management Team (SMT). Represents GSPV in relevant cross functional teams.

Qualificati

descriptionByLocale.it:
Situato all'interno del dipartimento CSLB.s SPGV, il Direttore, Global Safety Lead, Formulation Safety fornisce consulenza su tutti gli aspetti della sicurezza clinica durante l'intero ciclo di vita di un prodotto con particolare attenzione alla valutazione in corso delle informazioni sulla sicurezza durante lo sviluppo clinico e post-approvazione. (S)Applicherà una sana valutazione medica per l'analisi e l'interpretazione di dati clinici complessi di sicurezza per l'individuazione dei segnali e l'avvio di attività di gestione del rischio di sicurezza, tra cui specifiche di sicurezza, pianificazione del fotovoltaico e riqualificazione/contenzioso del rischio.

• integrare le attività di gestione dei rischi in materia di sicurezza del prodotto nel contesto medico, commerciale e normativo.

Il ruolo di rappresentante della sicurezza nei team di sviluppo interfunzionali e nei team di prodotti post-marketing è quello di definire una strategia di sicurezza per questi progetti globali. Per il successo del ruolo è necessaria una forte conoscenza dei prodotti.

Il ruolo assicura che gli standard medici e di processo forniti in CSLB siano in linea con i seguenti obiettivi di sicurezza attesi dai produttori da parte di soggetti interni ed esterni, tra cui regolatori, agenzie governative, finanziatori, medici, pazienti e il pubblico in generale:

• Rispetto dei requisiti legali e degli standard aziendali dei compiti e delle responsabilità del fotovoltaico (farmacovigilanza).

• Prevenzione dei danni da reazioni avverse nell'uomo derivanti dall'uso di medicinali autorizzati all'interno o all'esterno dei termini dell'autorizzazione al mercato o dall'esposizione professionale.

• Promuovere l'uso sicuro ed efficace dei medicinali, in particolare fornendo ai pazienti, agli operatori sanitari e al pubblico informazioni tempestive sulla sicurezza dei medicinali.

• Contribuire alla protezione dei pazienti e della salute pubblica.

Responsabilità e responsabilità

• Sicurezza Sorveglianza e Gestione del Rischio: Supervisiona i team di gestione della sicurezza garantendo un approccio accurato e coerente alla revisione dei dati di sicurezza emersi dagli studi clinici e dall'ambiente post-marketing. Supervisiona il processo di rilevamento dei segnali di sicurezza e valutazione dei segnali medici. Supervisiona l'analisi dei dati aggregati di sicurezza e la produzione di documenti aziendali chiave quali DSUR (Development Safety Update Reports), PSUR (Periodic Safety Update Reports) e piani di gestione dei rischi relativi alla sicurezza dei medicinali, che sono oggetto di revisione e discussione normative.

• Gestione della Qualità: garantisce la tempestiva produzione di report aggregati e risposte alle domande delle Autorità Sanitarie secondo standard qualitativi coerenti.

• Richieste di Agenzia di regolamentazione: Responsabile per risposte tempestive e concise alle richieste di Agenzia di regolamentazione relative alla sicurezza dei pazienti.

• Ispezioni: garantisce che i risultati delle ispezioni delle agenzie di regolamentazione e i risultati delle verifiche interne relativi ai prodotti di responsabilità siano affrontati e che i piani d'azione correttivi (Piani d'azione del PACA) siano attuati in modo efficiente ed efficace nella funzione.

• Sviluppo della sicurezza clinica del portafoglio CSLB: Supervisiona tutti i processi che portano alla produzione di sezioni di sicurezza e il contenuto dei documenti relativi agli studi clinici, inclusi protocolli, brochure di ricerca, moduli di consenso informato, rapporti di studio clinico. Supervisiona lo sviluppo delle informazioni fondamentali sulla sicurezza per i nuovi prodotti. Imposta la strategia, esamina e approva documenti di deposito chiave tra cui il Riassunto Integrato della Sicurezza (ISS), il Riassunto della Sicurezza Clinica (SCS) e i piani di gestione dei rischi (RMP).

Fornisce importanti contributi alle questioni attuali e potenziali in materia di sicurezza, essendo proattivo nell'affrontare le questioni di sicurezza e nell'istituire sistemi aggiuntivi per attenuare i rischi negli studi della CSNB. Fornisce orientamenti su varie questioni mediche, relative ai prodotti e relative ai processi in un ambiente medico e scientifico complesso, tra cui molti dipartimenti e funzioni di interfaccia.

• Rappresentazione della sicurezza clinica: presiede il team di gestione della sicurezza (SMT). Rappresenta l'SPGV in squadre trasversali pertinenti.

D.P.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Abteilung GSPV, Director Global Safety Lead, Formulation Safety, bietet im Rahmen der CSLB, der GSPV, Expertise zu allen Aspekten der – klinischen Sicherheit während des gesamten Lebenszyklus eines Produkts mit besonderem Schwerpunkt auf der laufenden Bewertung von Sicherheitsinformationen während der klinischen Entwicklung und nach der Zulassung. (S)Er wird eine solide medizinische Beurteilung für die Analyse und Interpretation komplexer klinischer Sicherheitsdaten für die Signalerkennung und die Einleitung von Sicherheitsrisikomanagement-Aktivitäten einschließlich Sicherheitsspezifikation, PV-Planung und Risikominimierung/-mitigierung vornehmen.

Integrieren Sie die Sicherheitsrisikomanagement-Aktivitäten des Produkts in ihren medizinischen, geschäftlichen und regulatorischen Kontext.

Die Rolle dient als Sicherheitsbeauftragter in den funktionsübergreifenden Entwicklungsteams und Post-Marketing-Produktteams. Sie ist verantwortlich für die Festlegung von Sicherheitsstrategien für diese globalen Projekte. Starkes Produktwissen ist für den Erfolg in der Rolle notwendig.

Die Rolle gewährleistet, dass die in der CSLB erbrachten medizinischen und verfahrenstechnischen Standards mit den folgenden Sicherheitszielen übereinstimmen, die von den Herstellern von internen und externen Akteuren wie Regulierungsbehörden, Behörden, Zahlern, Ärzten, Patienten und der Öffentlichkeit erwartet werden:

• Erfüllung der gesetzlichen Anforderungen und der Unternehmensstandards der PV- (Pharmacovigilance) Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten.

• Vermeidung von Schäden durch Nebenwirkungen beim Menschen, die durch die Verwendung von zugelassenen Arzneimitteln innerhalb oder außerhalb der Bedingungen der Marktzulassung oder durch berufliche Exposition entstehen.

• Förderung der sicheren und wirksamen Anwendung von Arzneimitteln, insbesondere durch rechtzeitige Information der Patienten, Angehörigen der Gesundheitsberufe und der Öffentlichkeit über die Sicherheit von Arzneimitteln.

• Beitrag zum Schutz der Patienten und der öffentlichen Gesundheit.

Zuständigkeiten und Rechenschaftspflichten

• Sicherheitsüberwachung und Risikomanagement: Überwacht Sicherheitsmanagement-Teams, die einen gründlichen und konsistenten Ansatz für die Überprüfung von Sicherheitsdaten aus klinischen Studien und aus der Post-Marketing-Umgebung gewährleisten. Überwacht die Sicherheitssignalerkennung und die medizinische Signalbewertung. Überwacht die Analyse von aggregierten Sicherheitsdaten und die Erstellung von Schlüsseldokumenten des Unternehmens wie DSURs (Development Safety Update Reports), PSURs (Periodic Safety Update Reports) und Risikomanagementpläne im Zusammenhang mit der Sicherheit von Arzneimitteln, die Gegenstand einer regulatorischen Überprüfung und Diskussion sind.

• Qualitätsmanagement: Gewährleistung der rechtzeitigen Erstellung von aggregierten Berichten und Antworten auf Anfragen von Gesundheitsbehörden nach einheitlichen Qualitätsstandards.

• Anfragen der Regulierungsagentur: Verantwortlich für die rechtzeitige und präzise Beantwortung von Anfragen der Regulierungsagentur im Zusammenhang mit der Patientensicherheit.

• Inspektionen: Gewährleistung der Einhaltung der Inspektionsergebnisse der Regulierungsbehörde und der internen Auditergebnisse in Bezug auf die Produkte der Verantwortung und der damit verbundenen Korrektur-Aktionspläne (CAPA-Pläne) in der Funktion effizient und effektiv.

• Klinische Sicherheitsentwicklung des CSLB-Portfolios: Überwacht alle Prozesse, die zur Herstellung von Sicherheitsabschnitten und zum Inhalt relevanter klinischer Prüfdokumente führen, einschließlich Protokollen, Prüferbroschüren, informierten Zustimmungsformularen, klinischen Studienberichten. Überwacht die Entwicklung von grundlegenden Sicherheitsinformationen für neue Produkte. Legt die Strategie fest, überprüft und genehmigt Schlüsseldokumente einschließlich Integrierter Zusammenfassung der Sicherheit (ISS), Zusammenfassung der klinischen Sicherheit (SCS) und Risikomanagementpläne (RMPs).

Er leistet wichtige Beiträge zu aktuellen und potenziellen Sicherheitsfragen, ist proaktiv bei der Lösung von Sicherheitsproblemen und der Einrichtung zusätzlicher Systeme zur Risikominderung in Studien der CSLB. Er gibt Orientierung zu verschiedenen medizinischen, produktbezogenen und prozessbezogenen Fragen in einem komplexen medizinischen und wissenschaftlichen Umfeld, einschließlich vieler Schnittstellenabteilungen und Funktionen.

• Klinische Sicherheitsvertretung: Vorsitzende des Safety Management Teams (SMT). Er vertritt die GSPV in relevanten crossfunktionalen Teams.

Qualifikate
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Situé au sein de la CSLB, le département du VSSP, le directeur, Sécurité mondiale plomb, Sécurité de la formulation, fournissent une expertise sur tous les aspects de la sécurité clinique tout au long du cycle de vie d'un produit, en mettant l'accent sur l'évaluation continue de l'information sur l'innocuité pendant le développement clinique et après l'approbation. (S)Il appliquera un jugement médical solide pour l'analyse et l'interprétation de données complexes sur l'innocuité clinique pour la détection des signaux et le lancement d'activités de gestion des risques de sécurité, y compris les spécifications de sécurité, la planification du VP et la minimisation/atténuation des risques.

Intégrer les activités de gestion des risques liés à la sécurité du produit dans leur contexte médical, commercial et réglementaire.

Le rôle est de représenter la sécurité dans les équipes de développement interfonctionnelles et les équipes de produits post-commercialisation. Il est responsable de l'établissement de la stratégie de sécurité pour ces projets mondiaux.

Le rôle consiste à s'assurer que les normes médicales et de processus fournies par la DGSCS sont conformes aux objectifs de sécurité suivants que les fabricants attendent des intervenants internes et externes, y compris les organismes de réglementation, les organismes gouvernementaux, les payeurs, les médecins, les patients et le grand public :

• Se conformer aux exigences légales et aux normes de l'entreprise en matière de tâches et de responsabilités de la PV (Pharmacovigilance).

• Prévenir les effets nocifs des effets indésirables sur l'homme résultant de l'utilisation de médicaments autorisés dans les conditions de l'autorisation de mise sur le marché ou en dehors de celle-ci ou de l'exposition professionnelle.

• Promouvoir l'utilisation sûre et efficace des médicaments, notamment en fournissant des informations en temps opportun sur la sécurité des médicaments aux patients, aux professionnels de la santé et au public.

• Contribuer à la protection des patients et de la santé publique.

Responsabilités et responsabilités

• Surveillance de l'innocuité et gestion des risques : Supervise les équipes de gestion de l'innocuité en veillant à ce que les données de sécurité issues des essais cliniques et de l'environnement post-commercialisation soient examinées de façon approfondie et cohérente. Supervise la détection des signaux de sécurité et le processus d'évaluation des signaux médicaux.

• Gestion de la qualité : assure la production en temps voulu de rapports agrégés et de réponses aux demandes des autorités sanitaires selon des normes de qualité cohérentes.

• Demandes de l'Agence de réglementation : Responsable des réponses rapides et concises aux demandes de l'Agence de réglementation concernant la sécurité des patients.

• Inspections : S'assurer que les constatations des organismes de réglementation en matière d'inspection et les constatations des audits internes concernant les produits relevant de la responsabilité sont prises en compte et que les plans d'action corrective (plans de l'ACP) qui en résultent sont mis en œuvre de façon efficace et efficiente dans la fonction.

• Développement de la sécurité clinique du portefeuille de la DGSCS : supervise tous les processus qui mènent à la production de sections de sécurité et le contenu des documents d'essais cliniques pertinents, y compris les protocoles, les brochures des chercheurs, les formulaires de consentement éclairé, les rapports d'études cliniques. supervise l'élaboration de l'information de base sur la sécurité des nouveaux produits.

Apporte une contribution importante aux questions actuelles et potentielles de sécurité, en étant proactif dans le traitement des questions de sécurité et en mettant en place des systèmes supplémentaires pour atténuer les risques dans les études de la DGSLC.

• Représentation clinique en matière de sécurité : préside l'équipe de gestion de la sécurité (SMT) qui représente le VSS dans les équipes interfonctionnelles pertinentes.

Qualificati

jobs.description:
The Director Non-Clinical Due Diligence & External Evaluations provides scientific leadership for nonclinical due diligence supporting CSL’s in‑licensing, acquisitions, and strategic collaborations. The role ensures integrated, objective, and decision‑relevant evaluations of nonclinical pharmacology, PK/QSP, and toxicology data to identify development risks, data gaps, and mitigation strategies and to inform portfolio decisions.
The incumbent will further act as nonclinical representative for selected Research programs and support oversight of nonclinical strategies and programs across all Therapeutic Areas.

The role reports to the Executive Director, Head of Nonclinical Development.

Responsibilities and accountabilities

• Leads operational execution of nonclinical due diligence for assigned opportunities.

• Acts as hands‑on scientific integrator, translating expert input into clear risk narratives.

• Trusted subject‑matter lead for nonclinical DD on individual deals.

• Lead end-to-end nonclinical due diligence for individual assets or transactions, from request through final governance readout.

• Integrate input from Toxicology, PK/QSP, Nonclinical Pharmacology, and external experts into a single, coherent scientific assessment.

• Identify FIH‑enabling gaps, translational risks, and regulatory limitations, with clear mitigation proposals.

• Prepare high‑quality DD reports, executive summaries, and risk tables for governance review.

• Act as NCD scientific interface to Business Development and Therapeutic Area teams at the project level.

• Contribute to maintenance and continuous improvement of nonclinical DD frameworks and templates.

• Mentor junior contributors and matrix team members as appropriate.

• Escalates complex or high‑impact issues to Head of NCD

• Chair of “NCD Review Committee”

Qualifications:
Education:

• Advanced degree (Ph.D., D.V.M., or equivalent) in toxicology, pharmacology, or a related field

• Toxicology training, board certification preferred

Experience :

• Experience in nonclinical development (10+ years) with proven experience in due diligence or external innovation, ideally across various geographies.

• Strong understanding of FIH‑enabling nonclinical requirements, particularly for biologics and complex modalities.

• Ability to communicate complex scientific risk clearly to non‑expert stakeholders.

• Experience across multiple therapeutic areas and modalities is highly desirable.

Competencies:

• Proven ability to work effectively both independently or in a team setting, and to meet set goals by managing own timelines.

• Experience in working in cross-functional, multicultural and international teams.

• Excellent communication and analytical skills.

• Experience in analyzing and presenting research results to scientific and professional audiences.

• Strong planning and organizational skills.

• Ability to work successfully in a matrix organizational structure.

• Strong negotiation skills and ability to identify and engage internal and external expertise as needed.

• Good understanding of drug development process, strong knowledge of ICH/GLP

• Fluent in English, oral and written;

The role requires onsite presence 3 days per week.
The role can be based in Zurich, Switzerland or Waltham, USA.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

• Graduate/professional degree in law, public health, international relations, political sciences or similar disciplines preferred.

• Experience partnering with patient groups to advance shared policy goals

jobs.description:
Position Summary
The Senior Director, Head of Medical Evidence reports into the Vice President, Head of Disease Areas and coordinates with Medical Affairs and cross-functional stakeholders to lead the Integrated Evidence Generation Plans (IEGP) for all marketed products and oversees the design and implementation of Medical Affairs evidence generation projects in alignment with GxP and business strategy.

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Responsible for oversight and delivery of the strategic integrated evidence generation plans (IEGPs) across therapeutic areas for pipeline and marketed medicines. This includes development, execution, and maintenance of data gap generation and analysis and governance and documentation of all IEGPs.

• Oversee design and implementation of Medical Affairs-led real-world evidence (RWE), epidemiological studies, HEOR, patient preference, and non-interventional studies. Guide development of phase IIIb/IV trials, registries, and observational studies. Ensure quality and timely delivery of study protocols, statistical analysis plans, and reports.

• Anticipate evidence gaps and proactively adjust tactical plans to serve the data needs of key stakeholders, including Regulatory authorities, HTAs, HCPs, and payers.

• Ensure all activities comply with GCP, regulatory standards, and internal policies. Manage budgets, timelines, and vendor relationships. Monitor and report on the impact of evidence generation activities.

• Oversees study tracking of all ongoing Medical Affairs evidence generation projects globally and provides regular reporting to Medical Affairs, including LT, MAST, DA leads.

• Enhance Medical Affairs capabilities in lifecycle management and phase 3b evidence generation.

• Partner with Global Program Teams, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, and Market Access. Lead or contribute to matrix teams and evidence generation sub-teams. Provides subject matter expertise and consultation to Medical Affairs colleagues in study development and design and interact, as required, with external research partners including investigators and vendors (including but not limited to CROs, database owners, registries, et). Provide support to Medical Disease Area teams for study execution as required.

Qualifications

Education:

• Advanced degree (MS/PhD/PharmD) with relevant scientific/medical background

Experience:

• Minimum of 12 years in pharmaceutical/biopharmaceutical industry inclusive of Medical Affairs.

• 8+ years’ experience in research related experience and/or pharmaceutical industry experience.

• Experience with late-stage clinical studies, research collaborations and RWE Proven track record of strong leadership, project management and demonstrated ability to coach and mentor individuals.

• Strong Regulatory and medical information communications knowledge and experience.

• Ability to communicate and interact thoughtfully, transparently, and appropriately with a variety of stakeholders both internal and external.

• Experience building and leading cross-functional team in a global matrix organization.

Competencies:

• Analytical thinking

• Business acumen

• Customer focus

• Communication clarity

• Emotional Intelligence (EQ)

• Perseverance

• Presentation expertise

• Priority setting

• Scientific expertise

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $303,000 - $371,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position in Waltham, MA as of the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

• Responsabile per la supervisione e la consegna dei piani strategici integrati di generazione di prove (IEGP) in aree terapeutiche per il gasdotto e farmaci commercializzati. Ciò include lo sviluppo, l'esecuzione e il mantenimento della generazione e dell'analisi e della governance e della documentazione di tutti gli IEGP.
• Superare la progettazione e l'attuazione delle prove del mondo reale guidate dagli affari medici (RWE), gli studi epidemiologici, HEOR, la preferenza dei pazienti e gli studi non intervenzionali. Sviluppo della guida di studi di fase IIIb/IV, registri e studi osservazionali. Assicurare la qualità e la consegna tempestiva di protocolli di studio, piani di analisi statistica e report.
• Anticipate lacune di prova e proattivamente aggiustare piani tattici per soddisfare le esigenze di dati dei principali stakeholder, tra cui autorità di regolamentazione, HTA, HCP e payers.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le attività siano conformi a GCP, agli standard normativi e alle politiche interne. Gestisci budget, timeline e relazioni con i fornitori. Monitorare e segnalare l'impatto delle attività di generazione delle prove.
• Supera il tracciamento di studio di tutti i progetti di generazione di prove mediche in corso a livello globale e fornisce report periodici agli Affari medici, tra cui LT, MAST, DA lead.
• Migliorare le capacità di affari medici nella gestione del ciclo di vita e la generazione di prove 3b di fase.
• Partner di Global Program Teams, Affari Medici, Sviluppo Clinico, Regolazione e Accesso al Mercato. Condurre o contribuire a squadre di matrice e sub-team di generazione di prove. Fornisce competenze di materia e consulenza ai colleghi di Affari medici nello sviluppo dello studio e nella progettazione e nell'interazione, come richiesto, con i partner di ricerca esterni tra cui investigatori e fornitori (compresi ma non limitati a CRO, proprietari di database, registri, et). Fornire supporto ai team di Area Malattia Medica per l'esecuzione di studio come richiesto. Qualifiche Istruzione:
• Grado avanzato (MS/PhD/PharmD) con relativo background scientifico/medico Esperienza:
• Minimo di 12 anni nell'industria farmaceutica/biofarmaceutica inclusi gli Affari medici.
• Esperienza di 8+ anni nell’esperienza di ricerca e/o nell’industria farmaceutica.
• Esperienza con studi clinici di fine fase, collaborazioni di ricerca e RWE Proven track record di forte leadership, la gestione del progetto e la capacità dimostrata di coach e persone mentore.
• Forte conoscenza e esperienza delle comunicazioni e delle informazioni mediche e regolamentari.
• Capacità di comunicare e interagire con pensiero, trasparenza, e in modo appropriato con una varietà di stakeholder sia interni che esterni.
• Esperienza di costruzione e leader team interfunzionale in un'organizzazione di matrice globale. Competenze:
• Pensiero analitico
• Business acumen
• Obiettivo del cliente
• chiarezza della comunicazione
• Intelligenza emotiva (EQ)
• Perseveranza
• Competenza di presentazione
• Impostazione prioritaria
• Competenza scientifica La gamma di stipendio base prevista per questa posizione a noleggio è $303,000 - $371,000. Si prega di notare che questa gamma di stipendio riflette la retribuzione minima e massima base che CSL si aspetta di pagare per questa posizione a Waltham, MA a partire dal momento della pubblicazione. Lo stipendio base individuale per un candidato di successo è determinato da qualifiche, livello di abilità, esperienza, competenze e altri fattori rilevanti. Principales responsabilités et responsabilités
• Responsable de la surveillance et de la mise en oeuvre des plans stratégiques intégrés de production de données probantes (PIE) dans les secteurs thérapeutiques des pipelines et des médicaments commercialisés. Cela comprend la mise au point, l'exécution et le maintien de la production et de l'analyse des lacunes en matière de données, ainsi que la gouvernance et la documentation de tous les GEIE.
• Superviser la conception et la mise en oeuvre des données probantes du monde réel (RWE), des études épidémiologiques, de la HEOR, de la préférence des patients et des études non interventionnelles. Assurer la qualité et la livraison en temps opportun des protocoles d'étude, des plans d'analyse statistique et des rapports.

• Améliorer les capacités des Affaires médicales dans la gestion du cycle de vie et la production de preuves de la phase 3b.

Fournir un soutien aux équipes de la Région des maladies médicales pour l'exécution des études, au besoin. Compétences Éducation:
• Diplôme avancé (MS/PhD/PharmD) avec expérience scientifique/médicale pertinente Expérience :
• Minimum de 12 ans dans l'industrie pharmaceutique/biopharmaceutique incluant les affaires médicales.
• 8+ ans d'expérience en recherche et/ou en industrie pharmaceutique.
• Expérience des études cliniques en fin d'étape, des collaborations de recherche et de RWE Expérience éprouvée d'un leadership solide, d'une gestion de projet et d'une capacité démontrée d'entraîneur et de mentor.

• Capacité de communiquer et d'interagir de façon réfléchie, transparente et appropriée avec divers intervenants internes et externes.
• Expérimenter et diriger une équipe interfonctionnelle dans une organisation matricielle mondiale. Compétences :

• Persévérance
• Expertise en présentation
• Définition des priorités

jobs.description:
Two Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of external innovation opportunities in Hematology, and Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. Embedded within each Therapeutic Area Leadership Team (TALT), these leaders will identify and advance high-potential assets from preclinical through Phase 1 clinical stages, shape early partnering strategies, and drive transactions in collaboration with Business Development ​

We have a hybrid office/home working model. The position will be based in Zurich (preferred) or Maidenhead, UK, with significant business travel

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior Early S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and ensuring external innovation priorities are integrated into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing and scouting efforts for preclinical and Phase 1 assets, building a robust pipeline of opportunities aligned with TA strategy. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Late Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Develop and execute early partnering strategies, including onboarding approaches and competitive positioning for priority assets. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for each opportunity, coordinating scientific, clinical, regulatory, and commercial assessments to inform governance decisions. ​

• Transaction Execution: Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and cultivating relationships with biotech, academia, and investment communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• Significant tenure in biopharma with significant experience in external innovation, search & evaluation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent). ​

• Must have Deep scientific expertise in Hematology or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of leading due diligence and closing early-stage deals. ​

• Strong network within biotech, academia, and pharma BD organizations. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforc

Le riunioni NPO sono checkpoint strategici dove le squadre cross-funzionali esaminano i potenziali assetti identificati dalla Ricerca e decidono se avanzarli per ulteriori valutazioni e negoziazioni di trattative. - Sviluppare e eseguire strategie di partnering iniziali, comprese le strategie di onboarding e la posizionamento competitivo per gli assetti di priorità. - Guidare la valutazione cross-funzionale per ciascuna opportunità, coordinando le valutazioni scientifiche, cliniche, regolatorie e commerciali per informare le decisioni di governance. - Esecuzione delle trattative: Collaborare strettamente con BD e Regional Ecosystem Leads per avanzare le opportunità di alta priorità attraverso la negoziazione e la chiusura del trattato, assicurando un passaggio senza intoppi e l'esecuzione. - Rappresentare la TA esternamente, guidando le attività di ricerca in conferenze specializzate e coltivando relazioni con la biotecnologia, l'istruzione accademica e le comunità di investimento. ##
• Requisiti e Esperienze - Tenuta significativa nella biotecnologia con esperienza significativa in innovazione esterna, ricerca e valutazione, o sviluppo aziendale. - Laurea specialistica richiesta (PhD, MD, o equivalente). - Deve avere una profonda conoscenza scientifica nelle aree terapeutiche di Ematologia o Cardiovascolare/Renale. - Provenienza di esperienze di leadership nella valutazione e chiusura di trattative iniziali. - Rete forte all'interno della biotecnologia, dell'istruzione accademica e delle organizzazioni di BD farmaceutico. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Modello di lavoro ibrido ufficio/casa. - Posizione basata a Zurigo (preferito) o Maidenhead, Regno Unito, con viaggi d'affari significativi. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni sui benefici di CSL visita [How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL](https://www.csl.com/). ## Descrizione CSL Behring è un leader globale di biofarmaceutici guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Focalizzati sul servire le esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le ultime tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e consegniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni nelle aree terapeutiche di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia di proteine ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e raffinare continuamente le modalità in cui i prodotti possono affrontare le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte e aiutare i pazienti a condurre vite complete. CSL Behring opera una delle reti di raccolta di plasma più grandi del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone e consegna le sue terapie salvavita a persone in più di 100 paesi. Per ulteriori informazioni su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Vifor visita [https://www.csl.com/](https://www.csl.com/) e CSL Plasma a [https://www.cslplasma.com/](https://www.cslplasma.com/).
descriptionByLocale.en:
Two Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of external innovation opportunities in Hematology, and Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. Embedded within each Therapeutic Area Leadership Team (TALT), these leaders will identify and advance high-potential assets from preclinical through Phase 1 clinical stages, shape early partnering strategies, and drive transactions in collaboration with Business Development ​

We have a hybrid office/home working model. The position will be based in Zurich (preferred) or Maidenhead, UK, with significant business travel

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior Early S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and ensuring external innovation priorities are integrated into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing and scouting efforts for preclinical and Phase 1 assets, building a robust pipeline of opportunities aligned with TA strategy. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Late Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Develop and execute early partnering strategies, including onboarding approaches and competitive positioning for priority assets. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for each opportunity, coordinating scientific, clinical, regulatory, and commercial assessments to inform governance decisions. ​

• Transaction Execution: Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and cultivating relationships with biotech, academia, and investment communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• Significant tenure in biopharma with significant experience in external innovation, search & evaluation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent). ​

• Must have Deep scientific expertise in Hematology or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of leading due diligence and closing early-stage deals. ​

• Strong network within biotech, academia, and pharma BD organizations. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforc

Mansions - Dienen Sie als Senior Leader von Early S & E innerhalb des TALT, beeinflussen Sie die therapeutische Strategie und stellen Sie sicher, dass externe Innovationsprioritäten in den Portfolioplan integriert werden. - Proaktive Forschungs- und Scouting-Bemühungen für präklinische und Phase 1, Aufbau einer robusten Pipeline von Möglichkeiten, die mit der TA-Strategie ausgerichtet sind - Co-Drive interne Meetings (mit dem Late Search Lead), die sich auf die Bewertung und Priorisierung von New Product Opportunities (NPO) in jedem CSL-Therapiebereich konzentrieren. NPO-Meetings sind strategische Kontrollpunkte, an denen funktionsübergreifende Teams potenzielle Vermögenswerte untersuchen, die von Research identifiziert wurden, und entscheiden, ob sie für weitere Bewertungen und Verhandlungen vorgeschlagen werden sollen. - Entwicklung und Umsetzung erster Partnering-Strategien, einschließlich Onboarding-Strategien und Wettbewerbspositionierung für Prioritäten. - Leitfaden für die funktionsübergreifende Bewertung für jede Gelegenheit, Koordinierung wissenschaftlicher, klinischer, regulatorischer und kommerzieller Bewertungen, um Governance-Entscheidungen zu treffen. - Durchführung der Verhandlungen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit BD und Regional Ecosystem Leads, um vorrangige Möglichkeiten durch Verhandlungen und Abschluss des Vertrags zu fördern und eine reibungslose Passage und Ausführung zu gewährleisten. - Vertretung der TA nach außen, Leitung von Forschungsaktivitäten in Fachkonferenzen und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Biotechnologie, akademischer Bildung und Investitionsgemeinschaften.
• Anforderungen und Erfahrungen - Bedeutender biotechnologischer Nachlass mit erheblicher Erfahrung in externen Innovationen, Forschung und Bewertung oder Geschäftsentwicklung. - Fachstudium erforderlich (PhD, MD oder gleichwertig). - Er muss über fundierte wissenschaftliche Kenntnisse in den therapeutischen Bereichen Hämatologie oder Herz-Kreislauf / Nieren verfügen. - Nachweis von Führungserfahrungen bei der Bewertung und dem Abschluss der ersten Verhandlungen. Starkes Netzwerk innerhalb der Biotechnologie, der akademischen Bildung und der pharmazeutischen BD-Organisationen. Was wir anbieten - Hybrid-Arbeitsmodell Büro / Haus. - Standort mit Sitz in Zürich (vorzugsweise) oder Maidenhead, Großbritannien, mit bedeutenden Geschäftsreisen. Weitere Informationen zu den Vorteilen von CSL finden Sie unter Wie CSL Ihr Wohlbefinden unterstützt | CSL. Beschreibung CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biopharmazeutika, der von unserem Versprechen geleitet wird, Leben zu retten. Konzentriert auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten mit den neuesten Technologien, entdecken, entwickeln und liefern wir innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen in den therapeutischen Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf und Stoffwechsel, Atmung und Transplantation. Wir nutzen drei strategische Wissenschaftsplattformen für die Plasmafraktionierung, rekombinante Proteintechnologie und Zell- und Gentherapie, um kontinuierliche Innovationen zu unterstützen und kontinuierlich zu verfeinern, wie Produkte unbefriedigte medizinische Bedürfnisse erfüllen und Patienten helfen können, ein vollständiges Leben zu führen. CSL Behring betreibt eines der weltweit größten Plasmasammelnetze, CSL Plasma. Unsere Muttergesellschaft CSL mit Sitz in Melbourne, Australien, beschäftigt 32.000 Mitarbeiter und liefert ihre lebensrettenden Therapien an Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern. Weitere Informationen zu CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus und CSL Vifor finden Sie unter https://www.csl.com/ und CSL Plasma unter https://www.cslplasma.com/.

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Director Search & Evaluation Late TA Lead, Immunology? The job is in our Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Switzerland or Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Position Description Summary ​

Senior Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of later-stage external Hematology therapeutic area. You will focus on opportunities from Phase 2 through marketed drugs, requiring deep clinical expertise, strong engagement with external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical investigators, and a keen understanding of evolving standards of care. The role is critical to shaping our portfolio through high-impact partnerships and transactions. ​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and integrating late-stage external innovation priorities into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing efforts for Phase 2 to marketed assets, identifying opportunities that align with TA strategy and unmet medical needs. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Early Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Engage extensively with external KOLs, clinical investigators, and networks to validate asset potential, understand trial designs & clinical endpoints, and anticipate competitive dynamics. ​

• Maintain deep awareness of changing standards of care and competitive landscapes to inform sourcing priorities and deal strategy. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for late-stage assets, coordinating clinical, regulatory, commercial, and market access assessments to support governance decisions. ​

• Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and building relationships with pharma, biotech, and clinical communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• 15+ years in biopharma with significant experience in clinical development, external innovation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (MD, PhD, or equivalent). ​

• Deep clinical expertise in Immunology, Hematology, or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of sourcing and closing late-stage deals and engaging with KOLs and clinical networks. ​

• Strong understanding of regulatory pathways, market access, and competitive standards of care. ​

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $263,000 - $328,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the listed for Waltham MA at the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

• Collaborare a stretto contatto con BD e i leader dell'ecosistema regionale per promuovere opportunità ad alta priorità attraverso la negoziazione e la conclusione degli accordi, garantendo un passaggio e un'esecuzione senza intoppi. ​
• Rappresentare l'AT all'esterno, guidando attività di sourcing in conferenze specializzate e costruendo rapporti con comunità farmaceutiche, biotecnologiche e cliniche. ​ Qualifiche e requisiti di esperienza ​
• Oltre 15 anni nel settore biofarmaceutico con esperienza significativa nello sviluppo clinico, nell'innovazione esterna o nello sviluppo aziendale. ​
• Laurea avanzata richiesta (medicinale, dottorato di ricerca o equivalente). ​
• Approfondita esperienza clinica nelle aree terapeutiche immunologica, ematologica o cardiovascolare/renale. ​
• Comprovata esperienza nell'approvvigionamento e nella chiusura di accordi in fase avanzata e nel coinvolgimento di KOL e reti cliniche. ​
• Forte conoscenza dei percorsi normativi, dell'accesso al mercato e degli standard di cura competitivi. ​ L'intervallo di stipendio base previsto per questa posizione al momento dell'assunzione è $ 263.000 - $ 328.000. Si prega di notare che questa fascia salariale riflette la retribuzione base minima e massima che CSL prevede di pagare per questa posizione presso l'elenco per Waltham MA al momento di questo annuncio. NPO-Meetings sind strategische Kontrollpunkte, an denen funktionsübergreifende Teams potenzielle Assets überprüfen, die von Search identifiziert wurden, und entscheiden, ob sie für weitere Due-Diligence-Prüfungen und Vertragsverhandlungen weiterverwendet werden sollen.
• Arbeiten Sie intensiv mit externen KOLs, klinischen Prüfärzten und Netzwerken zusammen, um das Asset-Potenzial zu validieren, Studiendesigns und klinische Endpunkte zu verstehen und die Wettbewerbsdynamik zu antizipieren. ​
• Behalten Sie ein tiefes Bewusstsein für sich ändernde Pflegestandards und Wettbewerbslandschaften bei, um Beschaffungsprioritäten und Geschäftsstrategien zu informieren. ​
• Fördern Sie die funktionsübergreifende Due Diligence für Vermögenswerte in der Spätphase und koordinieren Sie klinische, regulatorische, kommerzielle und Marktzugangsbewertungen, um Governance-Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. ​
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit BD und regionalen Ökosystem-Leads zusammen, um durch Verhandlungen und Geschäftsabschlüsse Chancen mit hoher Priorität voranzutreiben und eine reibungslose Übergabe und Ausführung sicherzustellen. ​
• Repräsentieren Sie den TA nach außen, leiten Sie Beschaffungsaktivitäten auf Fachkonferenzen und bauen Sie Beziehungen zu Pharma-, Biotech- und klinischen Communities auf. ​ Qualifikations- und Erfahrungsanforderungen ​
• 15+ Jahre in der Biopharmabranche mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der klinischen Entwicklung, externen Innovation oder Geschäftsentwicklung. ​
• Fortgeschrittener Abschluss erforderlich (MD, PhD oder gleichwertig). ​
• Umfassendes klinisches Fachwissen in den Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie oder Herz-Kreislauf-/Nierentherapie. ​
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Beschaffung und dem Abschluss von Spätphasengeschäften sowie der Zusammenarbeit mit KOLs und klinischen Netzwerken. ​
• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis der Regulierungswege, des Marktzugangs und wettbewerbsfähiger Pflegestandards. Die erwartete Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt bei Einstellung zwischen 263.000 und 328.000 US-Dollar. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Gehaltsspanne das minimale und maximale Grundgehalt widerspiegelt, das CSL zum Zeitpunkt dieser Veröffentlichung für diese Position bei Waltham MA zu zahlen erwartet. Das individuelle Grundgehalt eines erfolgreichen Kandidaten wird durch Qualifikationen, Fähigkeitsniveau, Erfahrung, Kompetenzen und andere relevante Faktoren bestimmt. Die Gesamtvergütung für diese Position kann neben dem Grundgehalt auch Anreizvergütung und Eigenkapital umfassen. #LI-HYBRID Über CSL Behring CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Biotherapeutika, angetrieben von unserem Versprechen, Leben zu retten. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, den Bedürfnissen der Patienten durch den Einsatz neuester Technologien gerecht zu werden, und entdecken, entwickeln und liefern innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'organisation R&D de CSL accélère l'innovation afin d'avoir un plus grand impact pour les patients. Grâce à une structure dirigée par projet et en mettant l’accent sur la collaboration, nous construisons une équipe prête pour l’avenir qui prospère dans des écosystèmes biotechnologiques dynamiques. Rejoindre CSL, c’est désormais faire partie d’une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. Pourriez-vous être notre prochain directeur principal, recherche et évaluation, responsable AT tardif, immunologie ? Le poste se déroule dans nos bureaux de Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Suisse ou Maidenhead UK. Il s'agit d'un poste hybride et est sur place trois jours par semaine. Résumé de la description du poste Les directeurs principaux de la recherche et de l'évaluation dirigeront l'approvisionnement stratégique et l'évaluation du domaine thérapeutique externe de l'hématologie à un stade ultérieur. Vous vous concentrerez sur les opportunités de la phase 2 jusqu'aux médicaments commercialisés, nécessitant une expertise clinique approfondie, un engagement fort avec les principaux leaders d'opinion (KOL) externes et les enquêteurs cliniques, ainsi qu'une compréhension approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins. Ce rôle est essentiel pour façonner notre portefeuille grâce à des partenariats et des transactions à fort impact. ​ Principales responsabilités et responsabilités ​
• Servir de leader senior en S&E au sein du TALT, en influençant la stratégie thérapeutique et en intégrant les priorités d'innovation externe à un stade avancé dans la planification du portefeuille. ​
• Diriger les efforts d'approvisionnement proactifs pour la phase 2 vers les actifs commercialisés, en identifiant les opportunités qui correspondent à la stratégie d'AT et aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits. ​
• Codiriger des réunions internes (avec le responsable de la recherche précoce) axées sur l'évaluation et la priorisation des opportunités de nouveaux produits (OBNL) dans les domaines thérapeutiques de chaque CSL. Les réunions des NPO sont des points de contrôle stratégiques où les équipes interfonctionnelles examinent les actifs potentiels identifiés par Search et décident de les faire avancer pour une diligence raisonnable plus approfondie et des négociations commerciales.
• S'engager largement avec des KOL externes, des enquêteurs cliniques et des réseaux pour valider le potentiel des actifs, comprendre les conceptions d'essais et les paramètres cliniques et anticiper la dynamique concurrentielle. ​
• Maintenir une connaissance approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins et des paysages concurrentiels pour éclairer les priorités d'approvisionnement et la stratégie de transaction. ​
• Mener une diligence raisonnable interfonctionnelle pour les actifs en phase de développement avancé, en coordonnant les évaluations cliniques, réglementaires, commerciales et d'accès au marché pour soutenir les décisions de gouvernance. ​
• Collaborer étroitement avec le BD et les responsables régionaux de l'écosystème pour faire progresser les opportunités hautement prioritaires grâce à la négociation et à la conclusion d'accords, garantissant un transfert et une exécution fluides. ​
• Représenter le TA à l'externe, diriger les activités d'approvisionnement lors de conférences spécialisées et établir des relations avec les communautés pharmaceutique, biotechnologique et clinique. ​ Exigences de qualifications et d'expérience ​
• Plus de 15 ans dans le domaine biopharmaceutique avec une expérience significative en développement clinique, en innovation externe ou en développement commercial. ​
• Diplôme d'études supérieures requis (MD, PhD ou équivalent). ​
• Expertise clinique approfondie dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de l'hématologie ou des maladies cardiovasculaires/rénales. ​
• Expérience avérée en matière de recherche et de conclusion d'accords à un stade avancé et d'engagement avec des KOL et des réseaux cliniques. ​
• Solide compréhension des voies réglementaires, de l'accès au marché et des normes de soins compétitives. ​ L'échelle salariale de base attendue pour ce poste au moment de l'embauche est de 263 000 $ à 328 000 $. Veuillez noter que cette échelle salariale reflète le salaire de base minimum et maximum que CSL s'attend à payer pour ce poste chez Waltham MA au moment de cette publication. Le salaire de base individuel d'un candidat retenu est déterminé par ses qualifications, son niveau de compétence, son expérience, ses compétences et d'autres facteurs pertinents. En plus du salaire de base, la rémunération totale pour ce rôle peut également inclure une rémunération incitative et des actions. #LI-HYBRID À propos de CSL Behring CSL Behring est un leader mondial des biothérapeutiques animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Axés sur la satisfaction des besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et proposons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant avec la maladie.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities:

• You will be responsible for scientific input to clinical development strategies and therapeutic areas.

• Provide scientific and clinical development input for the safe and efficient execution of assigned programs, ensuring the highest quality and full compliance of all outputs.

• Will contribute to the development of the scientific strategy of the clinical development plan, the design of trial related documents and the scientific oversight of clinical trials.

• You will facilitate a team to define and deliver the clinical strategy within programs.

• Define scientific strategy for multiple program components.

• You will lead the development of Clinical Development Program.

• Author clinical study documents and assists with development/critical review of submission documents.

• Contribute to authorship and review of manuscripts and conference abstracts.

• Collaboratively develop the clinical development strategy with project teams, providing input, guidance and mentorship for project teams.

• Contribute to the scientific analysis and interpretation of clinical data and the writing of clinical study reports, internal and external scientific meeting presentations and peer-reviewed publications, and all regulatory submission documents.

• Will foster close collaboration with other departments, defining and improving interfaces to other departments.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Science, Allied Health or Engineering.

• 8+ years experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry (or where relevant a biomedical research organization).

• 5+ years managing projects.

• In-depth knowledge in the drug development and manufacturing processes for pharmaceuticals (CMC, non-clinical, clinical, Regulatory Affairs).

The role is based in Glattbrugg, Switzerland and requires an onsite presence of 3 days per week.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the future.
To learn more about inclusion and belonging visit https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

Equal Opportunity Employer
CSL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, please visit https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

Responsabilità:

• Sarete responsabili per l'ingresso scientifico alle strategie di sviluppo clinico e aree terapeutiche.

• Fornire input di sviluppo scientifico e clinico per l'esecuzione sicura ed efficiente dei programmi assegnati, garantendo la massima qualità e la piena conformità di tutte le uscite.

• Contribuirà allo sviluppo della strategia scientifica del piano di sviluppo clinico, alla progettazione di documenti relativi alla sperimentazione e alla supervisione scientifica di studi clinici.

• Potrai facilitare un team per definire e fornire la strategia clinica all'interno dei programmi.

• Definire la strategia scientifica per più componenti del programma.

• Condurrai lo sviluppo del Programma di Sviluppo Clinico.

• Autore documenti di studio clinici e assiste con lo sviluppo / revisione critica dei documenti di presentazione.

• Contribuisci all'autore e alla revisione dei manoscritti e degli abstract di conferenze.

• Sviluppare la strategia di sviluppo clinico con i team di progetto, fornendo input, guida e mentorship per i team di progetto.

• Contribuire all'analisi scientifica e all'interpretazione dei dati clinici e alla scrittura di rapporti di studio clinici, presentazioni di incontri scientifici interni ed esterni e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed, e tutti i documenti di presentazione normativa.

• Favorirà una stretta collaborazione con altri reparti, definendo e migliorando le interfacce ad altri reparti.

Qualifiche:

• Laurea o equivalente in Scienze, Salute Alleata o Ingegneria.

• 8+ anni di esperienza nella biotecnologia o nell'industria farmaceutica (o dove pertinente un'organizzazione di ricerca biomedica).

• 5+ anni di gestione dei progetti.

• Conoscenza approfondita dei processi di sviluppo e produzione di farmaci per i prodotti farmaceutici (CMC, non clinici, regolamentari).

Il ruolo si svolge a Glattbrugg, in Svizzera e richiede una presenza in loco di 3 giorni a settimana.

Informazioni su CSL Behring
CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena.

CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi.
Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

I nostri vantaggi
Per ulteriori informazioni sui vantaggi CSL visita Come CSL supporta il tuo benessere | CSL .

Condividi su Twitter
A CSL, Inclusione e Belonging è al centro della nostra missione e chi siamo. Esso alimenta la nostra innovazione giorno in e giorno fuori. Festeggiando le nostre differenze e creando una cultura della curiosità e dell'empatia, siamo in grado di comprendere e connetterci meglio con i nostri pazienti e donatori, promuovere relazioni forti con i nostri stakeholder, e sostenere una forza lavoro diversificata che muoverà la nostra azienda e l'industria nel futuro.
Per saperne di più sull'inclusione e la visita di appartenenza https://www.csl.com/careers/inclusion-and-belonging

CSL è un Equal Opportunity Employer. Se sei un individuo con disabilità e hai bisogno di un alloggio ragionevole per qualsiasi parte del processo di applicazione, visita https://www.csl.com/accessibility-statement .

• Contribuer à la rédaction et à l'examen de manuscrits et de résumés de conférences.

• Élaborer en collaboration la stratégie de développement clinique avec les équipes de projet, en fournissant des commentaires, des conseils et du mentorat aux équipes de projet.

• Contribuer à l'analyse et à l'interprétation scientifiques des données cliniques et à la rédaction de rapports d'études cliniques, de présentations de réunions scientifiques internes et externes et de publications évaluées par des pairs, ainsi que de tous les documents de présentation réglementaires.

• Favorisera une collaboration étroite avec d'autres ministères, en définissant et en améliorant les interfaces avec d'autres ministères.

Qualifications

• 8 ans et plus d'expérience dans l'industrie de la biotechnologie ou pharmaceutique (ou, le cas échéant, dans un organisme de recherche biomédicale).

• 5 ans et plus de gestion de projets.

À propos de CSL Behring
CSL Behring est un chef de file mondial en biothérapeutique animé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients en utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et offrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant dans des conditions dans les domaines immunologiques, hématologiques, cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, respiratoires et transplantés. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques de fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement les façons dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie complète.

jobs.title: Director of Intellectual Property

titleByLocale.fr: Directeur of Intellectual Property

jobs.description:
The Director of Intellectual Property provides strategic support to CSL Research and Technical Operations organizations, with a primary responsibility for Tech Ops activities in Bern and Research in Schlieren (Zurich). In particular, the role will support CSL plasma and recombinant platforms within Technical Operations and Translational Research activities.

The Director of IP is responsible for identifying, protecting, managing, patent, trade secrets, exclusivities of all types and related intellectual property (IP) matters. Additionally, the Director of IP assesses patentability of inventions, potential infringement of patents and exclusivities, agreements involving patents, know-how, trade secrets and other exclusivity rights, and management of third-party IP risk. The position will work with some independence within the Global IP matrix work model to prepare, prosecute, maintain applications for the global patent portfolio, defend and enforce IP rights and partner with stakeholders and other CSL functions to maximize the value of IP for CSL.

Responsibilities

• Manage and deliver global patent and related intellectual property strategies and support for significant portion of CSL Group’s global activities, especially relevant to CSL Research and Technical Operations. Acts as primary IP contact for Technical Operations in respect of Albumin, Fractionation + Horizon 2 and local nominated Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) such as Ig/Inframarginals, Recombinants and Iron. The role will also serve as the IP advisor to selected European-based Research functions, including Drug Discovery, Translational & Data Science, Non-Clinical Development and associated project teams.

• Manage prosecution and defense of CSL intellectual property by supporting projects from early drug discovery to launch and beyond, including creating and safeguarding of a patent portfolio tailored to CSL’s activities with respect to pending applications and granted patents considering national and international laws and guidelines.

• Contributes to the delivery of enterprise-wide IP strategy for new and existing development-stage products, including optimizing and defending regulatory exclusivities and lifecycle management activities.

• Drive strategic patent filings for key Swiss-owned products (e.g. Privigen, Alburx) to maximise Swiss Patent Box benefits.

• Partner with European-based Research leadership to develop and implement IP strategies supporting pre-clinical programs, platform technologies and translational research activities across key therapeutic areas including Haematology, Cardiovascular & Renal, and Transplant & Immunology, Vaccines and Immunoglobulins.

• Contribute to the identification and preservation of Trade Secrets and, in conjunction with IP team, ensure trade secrets are well protected within the Global IP strategy alongside other IP rights.

• Lead invention harvesting, patent filing and portfolio development activities arising from Research and Technical Operations initiatives, including core technology platforms, manufacturing innovations, analytical methods, formulations, product improvements and next-generation product opportunities.

• Provide freedom to operate analysis across elected countries for assigned portfolio related risks, developing risk mitigation strategies and options and communicating to management and stakeholders.

• Partner with Technical Operations and Research as part of due diligence and deal opportunities.

• Participation in the negotiation of agreements involving patent and related intellectual property matters, such as, confidential disclosures, material transfer, request for proposal (RFP), licensing agreements and other related matters.

• Actively contributes to development of and delivery of education sessions to business partners on aspects of IP across the CSL enterprise.

• Represent CSL Group directly or in cooperation with external attorneys.

• Other complex tasks within the Intellectual

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Direttore della Proprietà Intellettuale fornisce un supporto strategico alle organizzazioni CSL Research and Technical Operations, con una responsabilità primaria per le attività Tech Ops a Berna e Research in Schlieren (Zurich). In particolare, il ruolo supporterà le piattaforme CSL plasma e ricombinanti all'interno delle attività di Operazioni Tecniche e Ricerca Traduttiva.

Il Direttore dell'IP è responsabile dell'identificazione, della protezione, della gestione, del brevetto, dei segreti commerciali, delle esclusioni di tutti i tipi e delle materie relative di proprietà intellettuale (IP). Inoltre, il Direttore IP valuta la brevettabilità delle invenzioni, la potenziale violazione dei brevetti e delle esclusioni, gli accordi che coinvolgono brevetti, know-how, segreti commerciali e altri diritti di esclusività, e la gestione del rischio IP di terzi. La posizione lavorerà con una certa indipendenza all'interno del modello di lavoro Global IP matrix per preparare, perseguire, mantenere le applicazioni per il portafoglio brevetti globale, difendere e far rispettare i diritti IP e collaborare con gli stakeholder e altre funzioni CSL per massimizzare il valore di IP per CSL.

responsabilità

• Gestire e fornire brevetti globali e relative strategie di proprietà intellettuale e supporto per una parte significativa delle attività globali del Gruppo CSL, particolarmente rilevanti per la ricerca e le operazioni tecniche CSL. Agisce come contatto IP primario per le operazioni tecniche nei confronti di Albumina, Frazione + Horizon 2 e le squadre di prodotti integrati nominate locali (IPT) come Ig/Inframarginals, Recombinants e Iron. Il ruolo sarà anche consulente IP per le funzioni di ricerca basate su Europa selezionate, tra cui Drug Discovery, Translational & Data Science, Non-Clinical Development e i team di progetto associati.

• Gestire l'accusa e la difesa della proprietà intellettuale CSL sostenendo progetti dalla scoperta precoce della droga al lancio e oltre, tra cui la creazione e la salvaguardia di un portafoglio di brevetti su misura per le attività di CSL rispetto alle domande in sospeso e brevetti concessi considerando le leggi e le linee guida nazionali e internazionali.

• Contribuisce alla fornitura di strategia IP a livello aziendale per i nuovi e esistenti prodotti di sviluppo-stadio, tra cui l'ottimizzazione e la difesa delle esclusioni normative e delle attività di gestione del ciclo di vita.

• Guidare i brevetti strategici per i prodotti chiave di proprietà svizzera (ad esempio Privigen, Alburx) per massimizzare i vantaggi Swiss Patent Box.

• Partner della leadership di ricerca europea per sviluppare e implementare strategie IP che supportano programmi preclinici, tecnologie di piattaforma e attività di ricerca traduttiva in aree terapeutiche chiave, tra cui Haematology, Cardiovascular & Renal, e Transplant & Immunology, Vaccines e Immunoglobulins.

• Contribuire all'identificazione e alla conservazione dei segreti commerciali e, in collaborazione con il team IP, garantire che i segreti commerciali siano ben protetti all'interno della strategia IP globale insieme ad altri diritti IP.

• Attività di raccolta, deposito di brevetti e sviluppo di portafoglio derivanti da iniziative di Ricerca e Operazioni Tecniche, comprese piattaforme di tecnologia di base, innovazioni di produzione, metodi analitici, formulazioni, miglioramenti dei prodotti e opportunità di prodotto di nuova generazione.

• Fornire la libertà di operare analisi nei paesi eletti per i rischi legati al portafoglio assegnato, sviluppare strategie di mitigazione del rischio e opzioni e comunicare alla gestione e agli stakeholder.

• Partner delle operazioni tecniche e della ricerca nell'ambito di due diligence e opportunità di negoziazione.

• Partecipazione alla negoziazione di accordi che coinvolgono brevetti e questioni relative di proprietà intellettuale, quali, divulgazione confidenziale, trasferimento di materiale, richiesta di proposta (RFP), accordi di licenza e altre questioni connesse.

• Contribuisce attivamente allo sviluppo e alla consegna di sessioni di istruzione a partner commerciali su aspetti di IP in tutta l'impresa CSL.

• Rappresentante CSL Gruppo direttamente o in collaborazione con avvocati esterni.

• Altri compiti complessi all'interno dell'Intellettuale
