descriptionByLocale.de:
Der Direktor für geistiges Eigentum leistet strategische Unterstützung für CSL-Forschungs- und technische Operations-Organisationen, mit der Hauptverantwortung für Tech Ops-Aktivitäten in Bern und Forschung in Schlieren (Zürich). Insbesondere wird die Rolle CSL-Plasma und rekombinante Plattformen im Rahmen von Technical Operations und Translational Research unterstützen.

Der Direktor des geistigen Eigentums ist für die Identifizierung, den Schutz, die Verwaltung, das Patent, Geschäftsgeheimnisse, Ausschließlichkeiten aller Art und damit verbundene Angelegenheiten des geistigen Eigentums (IP) verantwortlich. Darüber hinaus bewertet der IP-Direktor die Patentierbarkeit von Erfindungen, mögliche Verletzung von Patenten und Exklusivitäten, Patentvereinbarungen, Know-how, Geschäftsgeheimnisse und andere Exklusivitätsrechte sowie das Management von IP-Risiken Dritter. Die Position wird mit einer gewissen Unabhängigkeit innerhalb des globalen IP-Matrix-Arbeitsmodells zusammenarbeiten, um Anwendungen für das globale Patentportfolio vorzubereiten, zu verfolgen, zu pflegen, IP-Rechte zu verteidigen und durchzusetzen und mit Stakeholdern und anderen CSL-Funktionen zusammenzuarbeiten, um den Wert von IP für CSL zu maximieren.

Zuständigkeiten

• Verwalten und liefern Sie globale Patent- und verwandte Strategien für geistiges Eigentum und unterstützen Sie einen erheblichen Teil der globalen Aktivitäten der CSL Group, insbesondere für CSL Research and Technical Operations. Funktioniert als primärer IP-Kontakt für technische Operationen in Bezug auf Albumin, Fractionation + Horizon 2 und lokale nominierte Integrated Product Teams (IPTs) wie Ig / Inframarginals, Rekombinanten und Eisen. Die Rolle wird auch als IP-Berater für ausgewählte europäische Forschungsfunktionen dienen, darunter Drug Discovery, Translational & Data Science, Non-Clinical Development und assoziierte Projektteams.

• Verwalten Sie die Verfolgung und Verteidigung des geistigen Eigentums von CSL, indem Sie Projekte von der frühen Wirkstoffforschung bis zum Start und darüber hinaus unterstützen, einschließlich der Erstellung und Sicherung eines Patentportfolios, das auf die Aktivitäten von CSL in Bezug auf anhängige Anträge und erteilte Patente unter Berücksichtigung nationaler und internationaler Gesetze und Richtlinien zugeschnitten ist.

• Trägt zur Bereitstellung einer unternehmensweiten IP-Strategie für neue und bestehende Produkte in der Entwicklungsphase bei, einschließlich der Optimierung und Verteidigung regulatorischer Exklusivitäten und Lifecycle-Management-Aktivitäten.

• Führen Sie strategische Patentanmeldungen für wichtige Schweizer Produkte (z. B. Privigen, Alburx) durch, um die Vorteile der Swiss Patent Box zu maximieren.

• Partnerschaft mit der europäischen Forschungsleitung zur Entwicklung und Umsetzung von IP-Strategien zur Unterstützung präklinischer Programme, Plattformtechnologien und translationaler Forschungsaktivitäten in wichtigen therapeutischen Bereichen wie Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf & Nieren sowie Transplantat & Immunologie, Impfstoffe und Immunglobuline.

• Tragen Sie zur Identifizierung und Wahrung von Geschäftsgeheimnissen bei und stellen Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit dem IP-Team sicher, dass Geschäftsgeheimnisse im Rahmen der globalen IP-Strategie neben anderen IP-Rechten gut geschützt sind.

• Führen Sie Erfindungsernte, Patentanmeldung und Portfolioentwicklung, die sich aus Forschungs- und technischen Betriebsinitiativen ergeben, einschließlich Kerntechnologieplattformen, Fertigungsinnovationen, Analysemethoden, Formulierungen, Produktverbesserungen und Produktmöglichkeiten der nächsten Generation.

• Geben Sie die Freiheit, Analysen in gewählten Ländern für zugewiesene portfoliobezogene Risiken durchzuführen, Strategien und Optionen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln und mit Management und Stakeholdern zu kommunizieren.

• Partnerschaft mit Technical Operations und Research im Rahmen der Due Diligence und Deal-Möglichkeiten.

• Teilnahme an der Verhandlung von Vereinbarungen, die Patent- und verwandte Fragen des geistigen Eigentums betreffen, wie z. B. vertrauliche Offenlegungen, Materialtransfer, Antragstellung (RFP), Lizenzvereinbarungen und andere damit zusammenhängende Angelegenheiten.

• Trägt aktiv zur Entwicklung und Durchführung von Schulungen für Geschäftspartner zu Aspekten von IP im gesamten CSL-Unternehmen bei.

• Vertretung von CSL Gruppe direkt oder in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Anwälten.

• Andere komplexe Aufgaben innerhalb des Intellektuellen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le directeur de la propriété intellectuelle fournit un appui stratégique aux organismes de recherche et d'exploitation technique du CSL, dont la responsabilité première est d'effectuer les activités d'opérations techniques à Berne et de recherche à Schlieren (Zurich). En particulier, le rôle appuiera le plasma CSL et les plateformes recombinantes dans le cadre des activités d'exploitation technique et de recherche translationnelle.

Le directeur de la propriété intellectuelle est responsable de l'identification, de la protection, de la gestion, des brevets, des secrets commerciaux, des exclusions de tous types et des questions de propriété intellectuelle connexes. En outre, le directeur de la propriété intellectuelle évalue la brevetabilité des inventions, les atteintes potentielles aux brevets et aux exclusivités, les accords concernant les brevets, le savoir-faire, les secrets commerciaux et autres droits d'exclusivité, et la gestion du risque de propriété intellectuelle pour les tiers. Le poste travaillera avec une certaine indépendance dans le cadre du modèle de travail de la matrice mondiale de la propriété intellectuelle pour préparer, poursuivre, maintenir les demandes pour le portefeuille mondial de brevets, défendre et faire respecter les droits de propriété intellectuelle et s'associer avec les parties prenantes et d'autres fonctions CSL afin de maximiser la valeur de la propriété intellectuelle pour CSL.

Responsabilités

• Gérer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies mondiales en matière de brevets et de propriété intellectuelle et soutenir une partie importante des activités mondiales du Groupe CSL, en particulier celles qui concernent la recherche et les opérations techniques. Agit comme premier contact IP pour les opérations techniques en ce qui concerne l'albumine, Fractionation + Horizon 2 et les équipes de produits intégrées (IPT) désignées localement, comme Ig/Inframarginales, Recombinants et Fer. Ce rôle sera également le conseiller en propriété intellectuelle pour certaines fonctions de recherche européennes, notamment la découverte de médicaments, la traduction et la science des données, le développement non clinique et les équipes de projet associées.

• Gérer les poursuites et la défense de la propriété intellectuelle CSL en appuyant des projets allant de la découverte précoce de drogues au lancement et au-delà, y compris la création et la sauvegarde d'un portefeuille de brevets adapté aux activités de CSL.

• Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre d'une stratégie globale de propriété intellectuelle pour les produits nouveaux et existants, y compris l'optimisation et la défense des exclusivités réglementaires et des activités de gestion du cycle de vie.

• Produire des dépôts stratégiques de brevets pour des produits clés appartenant à la Suisse (p. ex. Privigen, Alburx) afin de maximiser les avantages de la Boîte aux brevets suisse.

• S'associer à la direction de la recherche européenne pour élaborer et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies de propriété intellectuelle soutenant les programmes précliniques, les technologies de plate-forme et les activités de recherche translationnelle dans des domaines thérapeutiques clés tels que l'hématologie, la cardio-vasculaire et le renal, la transplantation et l'immunologie, les vaccins et les immunoglobulines.

• Contribuer à l'identification et à la préservation des secrets commerciaux et, en collaboration avec l'équipe de la propriété intellectuelle, veiller à ce que les secrets commerciaux soient bien protégés dans le cadre de la stratégie mondiale de propriété intellectuelle aux côtés d'autres droits de propriété intellectuelle.

• Principales activités de récolte d'inventions, de dépôt de brevets et d'élaboration de portefeuilles découlant d'initiatives de recherche et d'exploitation technique, y compris les plates-formes technologiques de base, les innovations de fabrication, les méthodes d'analyse, les formulations, l'amélioration des produits et les débouchés de la prochaine génération.

• Fournir la liberté d'effectuer des analyses dans les pays élus pour les risques liés au portefeuille assignés, élaborer des stratégies et des options d'atténuation des risques et communiquer avec la direction et les parties prenantes.

• S'associer aux opérations et à la recherche techniques dans le cadre de la diligence raisonnable et saisir les occasions.

• Participation à la négociation d'accords portant sur des questions de brevets et de propriété intellectuelle connexes, telles que les divulgations confidentielles, le transfert de matériel, la demande de proposition, les accords de licence et autres questions connexes.

• Contribuer activement au développement et à la prestation de séances d'éducation aux partenaires commerciaux sur les aspects de la propriété intellectuelle dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise CSL.

• Représenter CSL Grouper directement ou en coopération avec des avocats extérieurs.

• Autres tâches complexes au sein de l'intellectuel

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead (Northern Europe & UK). The job is in our Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Serve as CSL’s key leader in the key innovation hubs to enhance the CSL external brand leading to BD deal flow to grow our pipeline. These senior leaders will combine ecosystem engagement, strategic scouting, and deal team leadership to ensure CSL maintains a strong presence and pipeline of opportunities across biotech, academia, and investment networks. This role partners with global R&D, business development, and legal teams to strengthen the organization’s innovation pipeline and competitive advantage. The individual will leverage deep internal organizational knowledge, align with the GLG, and internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to position CSL as the partner of choice in the key ecosystems of biotech innovation. ​

Main
• Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

· Serve as the key CSL leader within the regional innovation ecosystem, actively sourcing opportunities aligned with all TA strategies and portfolio priorities. Create new partnership opportunities for GLG presence within each ecosystem. ​
· Maintain and expand strategic relationships with universities, incubators, accelerators, venture capital firms, and local organizations to amplify CSL’s external innovation priorities.​
· Partner closely with TA Search Leads to conduct regional searches, plan engagements and conferences, and share regional insights and updates.​
· Serve as a senior member of deal teams occurring in each region, supporting transactions from identification through due diligence and help lead relationships with external partners through deal close.​
· Organize and represent CSL at local external innovation events, such as CSL-hosted innovation days, and ensure strong visibility in the ecosystem.​
· Actively participate as a board member in key industry bodies and associations and pursue board or committee memberships to influence industry direction and strengthen networks. ​
· Maintain intimate knowledge of internal organizational capabilities, priorities, and SMEs and engage internal experts to enhance credibility and reputation externally. ​
· Provide insights on regional biotech trends, competitive landscape, and innovation hotspots. ​
· Work closely with R&D, BD, and legal teams to evaluate and integrate external assets. ​

Qualifications & Experience
• Requirements​

· 10+ years in biopharma, external innovation, or business development with strong regional network and ecosystem knowledge.​
· Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent).​
· Proven track record of enhancing Pharma senior leadership presence/reputation as a partner of choice in biotech ecosystems to drive deal flow.​
· Proven ability to source and evaluate external opportunities and lead deal execution.​
· Strong relationship-building skills with academic, biotech, and investment communities. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'organizzazione R&D di CSL sta accelerando l'innovazione per dare maggiore impatto ai pazienti. Con una struttura guidata dal progetto e un focus sulla collaborazione, stiamo costruendo un team pronto per il futuro che prospera negli ecosistemi biotecnici dinamici. Unirsi a CSL significa ora essere parte di un team agile impegnato a sviluppare terapie che fanno una differenza significativa in tutto il mondo.

Potrebbe essere il nostro prossimo direttore, Regional Ecosystem Lead (Northern Europe & UK). Il lavoro è nella nostra Maidenhead UK Office. Questa è una posizione ibrida ed è in loco tre giorni alla settimana.

Servire come leader di CSL nei principali hub di innovazione per migliorare il marchio CSL esterno che porta al flusso di accordi BD per crescere il nostro pipeline. Questi leader senior uniranno l'impegno dell'ecosistema, lo scouting strategico e affronteranno la leadership del team per garantire che la CSL mantenga una forte presenza e pipeline di opportunità tra biotech, accademia e reti di investimento. Questo ruolo collabora con R&D globale, sviluppo aziendale e team legali per rafforzare la pipeline di innovazione dell'organizzazione e il vantaggio competitivo. L'individuo leverà profonda conoscenza organizzativa interna, allineare con il GLG, e gli esperti di materia interna (PMI) per posizionare la CSL come partner di scelta negli ecosistemi chiave dell'innovazione biotech.

Principale
• Responsabilità e responsabilità

· Servire come leader chiave della CSL all'interno dell'ecosistema regionale dell'innovazione, sourcing attivamente opportunità allineate a tutte le strategie TA e priorità di portafoglio. Crea nuove opportunità di partenariato per la presenza di GLG in ogni ecosistema.
· Mantenere e ampliare le relazioni strategiche con università, incubatori, acceleratori, imprese di capitale di rischio e organizzazioni locali per amplificare le priorità di innovazione esterna della CSL.
· Partner a stretto contatto con TA Search conduce a condurre ricerche regionali, impegni di piano e conferenze, e condividere approfondimenti e aggiornamenti regionali.
· Servire come membro senior dei team di affari che si verificano in ogni regione, sostenendo le transazioni dall'identificazione attraverso la dovuta diligenza e aiutare a condurre relazioni con i partner esterni attraverso l'affare vicino.
· Organizzare e rappresentare la CSL in eventi di innovazione esterna locale, come i giorni di innovazione ospitati dalla CSL, e garantire una forte visibilità nell'ecosistema.
· Partecipare attivamente come membro del consiglio di amministrazione in organi e associazioni chiave del settore e perseguire i membri del consiglio o del comitato per influenzare la direzione del settore e rafforzare le reti.
· Mantenere la conoscenza intima delle capacità organizzative interne, delle priorità e delle PMI e coinvolgere esperti interni per migliorare la credibilità e la reputazione esternamente.
· Fornire informazioni sulle tendenze biotech regionali, paesaggio competitivo e hotspot innovazione.
· Lavorare a stretto contatto con R&D, BD e team legali per valutare e integrare i beni esterni.

Qualifiche e esperienza
• Requisiti

· 10+ anni in biofarmacia, innovazione esterna, o sviluppo aziendale con una forte rete regionale e conoscenza dell'ecosistema.
· Grado avanzato richiesto (PhD, MD, o equivalente).
· Provato record di traccia di migliorare la presenza di leadership senior Pharma / reputazione come partner di scelta negli ecosistemi biotech per guidare il flusso di affare.
· Prova capacità di fonte e valutare le opportunità esterne e condurre l'esecuzione degli accordi.
· Forte capacità di costruzione di relazioni con le comunità accademiche, biotecnologiche e di investimento.

Informazioni su CSL Behring

Could you be our next Director, Regional Ecosystem Lead (Northern Europe & UK). The job is in our Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Serve as CSL’s key leader in the key innovation hubs to enhance the CSL external brand leading to BD deal flow to grow our pipeline. These senior leaders will combine ecosystem engagement, strategic scouting, and deal team leadership to ensure CSL maintains a strong presence and pipeline of opportunities across biotech, academia, and investment networks. This role partners with global R&D, business development, and legal teams to strengthen the organization’s innovation pipeline and competitive advantage. The individual will leverage deep internal organizational knowledge, align with the GLG, and internal subject matter experts (SMEs) to position CSL as the partner of choice in the key ecosystems of biotech innovation. ​

Main
• Responsibilities & Accountabilities​

· Serve as the key CSL leader within the regional innovation ecosystem, actively sourcing opportunities aligned with all TA strategies and portfolio priorities. Create new partnership opportunities for GLG presence within each ecosystem. ​
· Maintain and expand strategic relationships with universities, incubators, accelerators, venture capital firms, and local organizations to amplify CSL’s external innovation priorities.​
· Partner closely with TA Search Leads to conduct regional searches, plan engagements and conferences, and share regional insights and updates.​
· Serve as a senior member of deal teams occurring in each region, supporting transactions from identification through due diligence and help lead relationships with external partners through deal close.​
· Organize and represent CSL at local external innovation events, such as CSL-hosted innovation days, and ensure strong visibility in the ecosystem.​
· Actively participate as a board member in key industry bodies and associations and pursue board or committee memberships to influence industry direction and strengthen networks. ​
· Maintain intimate knowledge of internal organizational capabilities, priorities, and SMEs and engage internal experts to enhance credibility and reputation externally. ​
· Provide insights on regional biotech trends, competitive landscape, and innovation hotspots. ​
· Work closely with R&D, BD, and legal teams to evaluate and integrate external assets. ​

Qualifications & Experience
• Requirements​

· 10+ years in biopharma, external innovation, or business development with strong regional network and ecosystem knowledge.​
· Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent).​
· Proven track record of enhancing Pharma senior leadership presence/reputation as a partner of choice in biotech ecosystems to drive deal flow.​
· Proven ability to source and evaluate external opportunities and lead deal execution.​
· Strong relationship-building skills with academic, biotech, and investment communities. ​

Starke Fähigkeiten zum Aufbau von Beziehungen zu akademischen, Biotech- und Investmentgemeinschaften.

Servir de chef de file clé dans les pôles d'innovation clés pour améliorer la marque externe CSL menant au flux de transactions BD pour développer notre pipeline. Ces cadres supérieurs combineront l'engagement dans les écosystèmes, le dépistage stratégique et le leadership de l'équipe de négociation pour s'assurer que CSL maintient une forte présence et une gamme d'occasions dans les réseaux de biotechnologie, d'université et d'investissement. Principale

· Maintenir une connaissance intime des capacités organisationnelles internes, des priorités et des PME et faire appel à des experts internes pour accroître la crédibilité et la réputation à l'extérieur.
· Fournir des renseignements sur les tendances régionales en biotechnologie, le paysage concurrentiel et les points chauds de l'innovation.
· Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de R-D, de BD et de droit pour évaluer et intégrer les actifs externes.

Qualifications et expérience
• Exigences

· 10 ans et plus dans le domaine de la biopharmacie, de l'innovation externe ou du développement d'entreprises ayant une solide connaissance des réseaux régionaux et des écosystèmes.
· Diplôme avancé requis (PhD, MD ou équivalent).

jobs.description:
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to join our team in Bern, Switzerland. In this role, you will partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to attract, assess, and hire top talent across a variety of functions. You will serve as a trusted advisor throughout the recruitment process, leveraging market insights, sourcing expertise, and a candidate-centric approach to deliver exceptional hiring outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

• Manage end-to-end recruitment processes across multiple functions and business areas, ensuring the delivery of high-quality talent aligned with business objectives.

• Partner with hiring managers and key stakeholders to understand hiring needs, develop recruitment strategies, and provide market intelligence and talent advisory support.

• Lead the full recruitment lifecycle, including job briefing, job posting, sourcing, screening, interviewing, candidate assessment, offer preparation, and onboarding support.

• Proactively source and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, networking, referrals, and other innovative sourcing channels.

• Ensure an outstanding candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.

• Utilize Workday and recruiting analytics to track, measure, and report on recruitment performance, pipeline health, and key hiring metrics.

• Collaborate with regional and global Talent Acquisition colleagues on international searches, talent mapping, and strategic sourcing initiatives.

• Build and maintain effective partnerships with external recruitment agencies and staffing providers, ensuring quality, compliance, and cost-effectiveness.

• Contribute to Talent Acquisition projects and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance recruitment effectiveness and employer branding.

• Steer and support designated initiatives for our local Early Career program.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• Minimum of 5 years of full-cycle recruitment experience, preferably within Switzerland or DACH region.

• Demonstrated experience recruiting for manufacturing, production or operations environments.

• Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or other highly regulated industries is highly desirable.

• Previous in-house recruitment experience is required, an additional background in executive search or business partnering is a plus.

• Strong sourcing capabilities with hands-on experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other talent attraction tools.

• Experience working with applicant tracking systems, ideally Workday.

• Strong stakeholder management, influencing, and communication skills.

• Fluent German and English skills are mandatory.

What we offer:

• Competitive salary adn comprehensive benefits package.

• Up to two additioanl leave days for your personal wellbeing.

• Hybrid working model with up to two days working from home per week.

• Access to learning and development opportunities through our CSL Academy.

• CSL subsidized on-site canteen
For more information, please see our global benifits below.

We are looking forward to your application. Please ensure to apply online with your CV and certifications.

• L'esperienza all'interno della farmaceutica, biotecnologia, dispositivo medico, o altre industrie altamente regolamentate è altamente auspicabile.

• È necessaria una precedente esperienza di reclutamento interna e/o esperienza all'interno di un'agenzia di reclutamento.

• Forte capacità di approvvigionamento con esperienza pratica utilizzando LinkedIn Recruiter e altri strumenti di attrazione del talento.

• Esperienza di lavoro con i sistemi di monitoraggio dei candidati, idealmente Workday.

• Forte gestione degli stakeholder, influenza e capacità di comunicazione.

• Fluente in tedesco e inglese; competenze linguistiche aggiuntive sono un plus

Cosa offriamo:

• Competitivo stipendio adn pacchetto benefici completo.

• Fino a due additioanl lasciano giorni per il vostro benessere personale.

jobs.description:
CSL is transforming its R&D organization to accelerate innovation and create greater impact for patients. With a streamlined, project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we're building a future-ready team that excels in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Clinical Scientist? The job is in our King of Prussia, PA or Glattbrugg Switzerland office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Reporting to a Global Clinical Scientist Lead, you will support multifunctional, clinical projects in the Cardiovascular-Renal Therapeutic Area. You will work with the Program Director and other Clinical Scientists in performing delegated tasks to support the clinical development program as dictated by therapeutic area/ project needs.

The Role

• Help develop individual clinical studies according to the clinical development plan within the assigned therapeutic area.

• Provide scientific input for the safe and efficient execution of assigned studies, ensuring the highest quality and full compliance of all outputs.

• Help develop high-quality program and study level documents and training materials aligned with project plans (e.g. clinical development plan, IB, protocols, eCRF, ICF, study reference manuals, investigator trainings, clinical study report and regulatory submission documents) in compliance with federal regulations, GCP and good medical practice. regulatory submission documents

• Provide clinical science input into design and review of eCRF, SAP, and TLFs.

• Support the scientific data analysis and interpretation and help write clinical study reports, internal and external scientific meeting presentations, and publications.

• Support the medical monitoring and oversight of individual clinical studies with an emphasis on subject safety and eligibility, data integrity, trend identification, analysis and remediation, including ongoing review of blinded data, use of data visualization tools and programmed reports.

• Identify clinical data trends, issue and resolve corresponding queries, ensure consistency of medical coding and other important data and identification of cases for medical review. Ensure all questions / issues requiring medical oversight are brought to the attention of the Medical monitor.

• Manage the processes and partnerships required to support external study oversight committees (e.g. Steering committee, independent data monitoring committee, clinical events committee).

• Collaborate with internal and external partners to ensure translation of the clinical protocol into operational deliverables, serve as primary contact for protocol guidance, provide training to the clinical execution team.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree, or equivalent with minimum of 5 years' experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry (or biomedical research organization) required; OR Advanced degree (Master's, PhD) with relevant clinical focus and minimum 3 years experience

• Knowledge in the drug development processes for pharmaceuticals with experience in biotherapeutics desirable (e.g. therapeutic proteins, monoclonal antibodies), and demonstrated ability to use systems and tools (e.g., EDC systems) for data collection, analysis and reporting.

• The ability to work collaboratively in a matrix environment is necessary.

• Experience working with CROs and AROs, including providing oversight.

• Proficient knowledge and technical skills to support study specific data review, trend identification, data interpretation

descriptionByLocale.en:
CSL is transforming its R&D organization to accelerate innovation and create greater impact for patients. With a streamlined, project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we're building a future-ready team that excels in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Clinical Scientist? The job is in our King of Prussia, PA or Glattbrugg Switzerland office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Reporting to a Global Clinical Scientist Lead, you will support multifunctional, clinical projects in the Cardiovascular-Renal Therapeutic Area. You will work with the Program Director and other Clinical Scientists in performing delegated tasks to support the clinical development program as dictated by therapeutic area/ project needs.

The Role

• Help develop individual clinical studies according to the clinical development plan within the assigned therapeutic area.

• Provide scientific input for the safe and efficient execution of assigned studies, ensuring the highest quality and full compliance of all outputs.

• Help develop high-quality program and study level documents and training materials aligned with project plans (e.g. clinical development plan, IB, protocols, eCRF, ICF, study reference manuals, investigator trainings, clinical study report and regulatory submission documents) in compliance with federal regulations, GCP and good medical practice. regulatory submission documents

• Provide clinical science input into design and review of eCRF, SAP, and TLFs.

• Support the scientific data analysis and interpretation and help write clinical study reports, internal and external scientific meeting presentations, and publications.

• Support the medical monitoring and oversight of individual clinical studies with an emphasis on subject safety and eligibility, data integrity, trend identification, analysis and remediation, including ongoing review of blinded data, use of data visualization tools and programmed reports.

• Identify clinical data trends, issue and resolve corresponding queries, ensure consistency of medical coding and other important data and identification of cases for medical review. Ensure all questions / issues requiring medical oversight are brought to the attention of the Medical monitor.

• Manage the processes and partnerships required to support external study oversight committees (e.g. Steering committee, independent data monitoring committee, clinical events committee).

• Collaborate with internal and external partners to ensure translation of the clinical protocol into operational deliverables, serve as primary contact for protocol guidance, provide training to the clinical execution team.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree, or equivalent with minimum of 5 years' experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry (or biomedical research organization) required; OR Advanced degree (Master's, PhD) with relevant clinical focus and minimum 3 years experience

• Knowledge in the drug development processes for pharmaceuticals with experience in biotherapeutics desirable (e.g. therapeutic proteins, monoclonal antibodies), and demonstrated ability to use systems and tools (e.g., EDC systems) for data collection, analysis and reporting.

• The ability to work collaboratively in a matrix environment is necessary.

• Experience working with CROs and AROs, including providing oversight.

• Proficient knowledge and technical skills to support study specific data review, trend identification, data interpretation

descriptionByLocale.de:

Mit einer schlanken, projektgeführten Struktur und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit bauen wir ein zukunftsfähiges Team auf, das sich in dynamischen Biotech-Ökosystemen auszeichnet. Als Global Clinical Scientist Lead unterstützen Sie multifunktionale, klinische Projekte im kardiovaskulär-renalen Therapiebereich. B. klinischer Entwicklungsplan, IB, Protokolle, eCRF, ICF, Studienreferenzhandbücher, Prüferschulungen, klinischer Studienbericht und behördliche Vorlagedokumente) in Übereinstimmung mit Bundesvorschriften, GCP und guter medizinischer Praxis. S'assurer que toutes les questions/questions nécessitant une surveillance médicale sont portées à l'attention du surveillant médical.

• Collaborer avec des partenaires internes et externes pour assurer la traduction du protocole clinique en produits livrables opérationnels, servir de premier contact pour l'orientation du protocole, fournir une formation à l'équipe d'exécution clinique.

• La connaissance des processus de développement des médicaments pour les produits pharmaceutiques possédant une expérience en biothérapie est souhaitable (p. ex. protéines thérapeutiques, anticorps monoclonaux) et a démontré la capacité d'utiliser des systèmes et des outils (p. ex. systèmes EDC) pour la collecte, l'analyse et la déclaration des données.

• La capacité de travailler en collaboration dans un environnement matriciel est nécessaire.

• Expérience de travail avec les ORC et les ORA, y compris la surveillance.

• Connaissances et compétences techniques suffisantes pour appuyer l'examen des données spécifiques, l'identification des tendances, l'interprétation des données

jobs.title: Associate Director, Device Engineering

titleByLocale.fr: Associate Directeur, Device Engineering

jobs.description:
The Associate Director of Device Engineering is a leadership position in the Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) department within CSL’s Technical Operations. This role will report to the Director of Design Assurance.

The ideal candidate has a solid track record in the development of drug delivery devices, from concept development through commercialization and product maintenance, i.e., sustaining. The Associate Director of Device Engineering provides combination-product leadership and ensures that device-related development plans and evidence packages are integrated into the overall CMC and product strategy. The role requires strong cross-functional and external partner leadership, engineering team management, and stakeholder management.

Responsibilities

• Lead the Device Engineering team for drug–device combination product development across assigned assets, coordinating cross-functional inputs from Device Engineering, Human Factors, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical/Medical, Procurement, Manufacturing/Technical Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial, and external partners.

• Support and mentor Device Engineering team members, developing technical and leadership skills.

• Lead and coordinate device selection and development activities appropriate to the development stage, including inputs, outputs, verification and validation planning, supplier qualification, test strategy, documentation readiness, and regulatory submission support. Own and maintain the Design History File (DHF), ensuring documentation is complete, accurate, inspection-ready, and compliant with the CSL quality system and applicable regulatory frameworks for combination products.

• Translate user needs and program strategy into product requirements, development plans, milestones, risks, and deliverables. Ensure alignment between device design, Primary Packaging, Secondary Packaging, Human Factors, and overall CMC/product strategy.

• Lead risk management activities, including hazard analysis, risk assessments, and mitigation planning. Plan and implement combination product control strategy across supply in alignment with CMC. Support human factors and usability activities to ensure the user interface, instructional materials, and intended-use considerations align with patient needs and regulatory expectations. Set and drive best practices within DDSP for Device Engineering, including standardized approaches for design risk assessment, biological evaluation, and other key deliverables.

• Represent the device engineering team on cross-functional program teams and ensure combination product deliverables are aligned with program needs. Create, manage, and execute integrated workplans, timelines, decision logs, meeting cadences, risk registers, and escalation pathways. Partner with project leads and development teams to ensure clear priorities, timely execution, and effective resolution of risks and dependencies.

• Establish and maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, vendors, OEMs, testing labs, CMOs, and other external partners to enable development, qualification, and submission-supporting activities. Support sourcing strategy, due diligence, and business development assessments related to combination products within the scope of technical expertise.

• Implement and approve end-to-end capabilities for drug–device combination development within Drug Product Development, including playbooks, templates, best practices, and knowledge-sharing approaches. Drive innovation through technology scouting and evaluation, identifying opportunities to improve patient experience, manufacturability, robustness, and lifecycle flexibility. Represent CSL interests in industry forums such as ISO TCs and BioPhorum as well as sharing information from industry forums back to CSL colleagues.

• Own program-level tracking of timelines, risks, decisions, and deliverables to communicate progress clearly. Mentor Device Engineers, promote consistency across programs,

descriptionByLocale.it:
Il Direttore Associato di Ingegneria dei Dispositivi è una posizione di leadership nel reparto Sistemi di Consegna della Droga & Packaging (DDSP) all'interno delle operazioni tecniche di CSL. Questo ruolo si riferirà al Direttore dell'Assurance del Design.

Il candidato ideale ha un solido record di traccia nello sviluppo di dispositivi di consegna della droga, dallo sviluppo del concetto attraverso la commercializzazione e la manutenzione del prodotto, cioè, sostenendo. L'Associated Director of Device Engineering fornisce la leadership dei prodotti combinati e garantisce che i piani di sviluppo e i pacchetti di prova relativi ai dispositivi siano integrati nella strategia globale CMC e dei prodotti. Il ruolo richiede una forte leadership partner interfunzionale ed esterna, la gestione del team di ingegneria e la gestione degli stakeholder.

responsabilità

• Guidare il team di Ingegneria del dispositivo per lo sviluppo di prodotti combinati droga-dispositivo tra i beni assegnati, coordinando gli input interfunzionali da Ingegneria del dispositivo, Fattori Umani, Qualità, Regolazione, Clinica/Medical, Procurement, Manufacturing/Technical Operations, Supply Chain, Commerciale e partner esterni.

• Supporto e mentore Componenti del team di Ingegneria dei dispositivi, lo sviluppo di competenze tecniche e di leadership.

• Guidare e coordinare le attività di selezione e sviluppo dei dispositivi appropriate alla fase di sviluppo, compresi gli input, le uscite, la pianificazione della verifica e della validazione, la qualificazione dei fornitori, la strategia di test, la disponibilità della documentazione e il supporto di presentazione della normativa. Possedere e mantenere il Design History File (DHF), assicurando la documentazione è completa, accurata, pronta all'ispezione e conforme al sistema di qualità CSL e ai quadri normativi applicabili per i prodotti combinati.

• Tradurre le esigenze degli utenti e la strategia di programma in requisiti di prodotto, piani di sviluppo, pietre miliari, rischi e consegnabili. Assicurare l'allineamento tra progettazione del dispositivo, imballaggio primario, imballaggio secondario, fattori umani e strategia CMC / prodotto generale.

• Leader attività di gestione dei rischi, tra cui analisi dei rischi, valutazione dei rischi e pianificazione della mitigazione. Pianificare e implementare la strategia di controllo combinata del prodotto attraverso la fornitura in allineamento con CMC. Sostenere i fattori umani e le attività di usabilità per garantire l'interfaccia utente, i materiali didattici, e le considerazioni di utilizzo mirate allineare con le esigenze del paziente e le aspettative normative. Impostare e guidare le migliori pratiche all'interno di DDSP per l'ingegneria dei dispositivi, compresi gli approcci standardizzati per la valutazione del rischio di progettazione, la valutazione biologica e altri consegnabili chiave.

• Rappresentare il team di ingegneria del dispositivo su team di programma interfunzionali e garantire la combinazione di prodotti consegnabili sono allineati con le esigenze del programma. Creare, gestire ed eseguire piani di lavoro integrati, linee temporali, registri delle decisioni, cadenze delle riunioni, registri dei rischi e percorsi di escalation. Partner con project lead e team di sviluppo per garantire priorità chiare, esecuzione tempestiva e risoluzione efficace dei rischi e delle dipendenze.

• Stabilire e mantenere forti rapporti di lavoro con fornitori, fornitori, OEM, laboratori di prova, CMO e altri partner esterni per consentire lo sviluppo, la qualificazione e le attività di supporto alla presentazione. Sostenere la strategia di approvvigionamento, la due diligence e le valutazioni di sviluppo aziendale relative ai prodotti combinati nell'ambito delle competenze tecniche.

• Implementare e approvare le capacità end-to-end per lo sviluppo di combinazione di droga-dispositivo all'interno dello sviluppo del prodotto di droga, compresi i playbook, i modelli, le best practice e gli approcci di condivisione della conoscenza. Guidare l'innovazione attraverso lo scouting tecnologico e la valutazione, identificare le opportunità per migliorare l'esperienza del paziente, la manifatturabilità, la robustezza e la flessibilità del ciclo di vita. Rappresentare gli interessi CSL nei forum del settore, come ISO TCs e BioPhorum, così come la condivisione di informazioni dai forum del settore di nuovo ai colleghi CSL.

• Il proprio monitoraggio a livello di programma di linee temporali, rischi, decisioni e consegnabili per comunicare chiaramente il progresso. Gli ingegneri del dispositivo del mentore, promuovono la consistenza attraverso i programmi,

Nachhaltigkeit. • Führen Sie das Device Engineering-Team für die Entwicklung von Kombinationsprodukten für Arzneimittel und Geräte über zugewiesene Assets hinweg und koordinieren Sie funktionsübergreifende Inputs von Device Engineering, Human Factors, Quality, Regulatory, Clinical / Medical, Procurement, Manufacturing / Technical Operations, Supply Chain, Commercial und externen Partnern.

• Support und Mentor Device Engineering Teammitglieder, Entwicklung von technischen und Führungsqualitäten.

• Leiten und koordinieren Sie die für die Entwicklungsphase geeigneten Produktauswahl- und -entwicklungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Inputs, Outputs, Verifizierungs- und Validierungsplanung, Lieferantenqualifizierung, Teststrategie, Dokumentationsbereitschaft und Unterstützung bei der Einreichung von Vorschriften. Besitzen und pflegen Sie die Design History File (DHF), um sicherzustellen, dass die Dokumentation vollständig, genau, prüfbereit und konform mit dem CSL-Qualitätssystem und den geltenden gesetzlichen Rahmenbedingungen für Kombinationsprodukte ist.

• Übersetzen Sie Benutzerbedürfnisse und Programmstrategien in Produktanforderungen, Entwicklungspläne, Meilensteine, Risiken und Ergebnisse. Stellen Sie eine Abstimmung zwischen Gerätedesign, Primärverpackung, Sekundärverpackung, Human Factors und der gesamten CMC / Produktstrategie sicher.

• Leitung von Risikomanagementtätigkeiten, einschließlich Gefahrenanalysen, Risikobewertungen und Risikominderungsplanung. Planen und implementieren Sie eine Strategie zur Steuerung von Kombinationsprodukten in Übereinstimmung mit CMC. Unterstützen Sie menschliche Faktoren und Usability-Aktivitäten, um sicherzustellen, dass die Benutzeroberfläche, das Lehrmaterial und die Verwendungszwecküberlegungen mit den Bedürfnissen der Patienten und den regulatorischen Erwartungen übereinstimmen. Support Sourcing Strategie, Due Diligence und Business Development Assessments im Zusammenhang mit Kombinationsprodukten im Rahmen der technischen Expertise.

Förderung der Innovation durch Technologie-Scouting und -Evaluierung, Ermittlung von Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Patientenerfahrung, Herstellbarkeit, Robustheit und Flexibilität des Lebenszyklus. Vertretung von CSL-Interessen in Branchenforen wie ISO TCs und BioPhorum sowie Austausch von Informationen aus Branchenforen an CSL-Kollegen.

• Eigenes Programm-Level-Tracking von Zeitlinien, Risiken, Entscheidungen und Leistungen, um den Fortschritt klar zu kommunizieren. Mentor Device Engineers, fördern Konsistenz über Programme hinweg,
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Le directeur associé de l'ingénierie des matériels est un poste de chef de file au sein du département Systèmes de livraison de médicaments et emballage (DDSP) au sein des Opérations techniques du CSL. Ce rôle relèvera du directeur de l'assurance de la conception.

Le candidat idéal a une solide expérience dans la mise au point d'appareils de distribution de médicaments, depuis l'élaboration de concepts jusqu'à la commercialisation et l'entretien des produits, c'est-à-dire le maintien. Le directeur associé de l'ingénierie des appareils assure le leadership de la combinaison des produits et veille à ce que les plans de développement des appareils et les ensembles de données probantes soient intégrés à la stratégie globale du CMC et des produits. Ce rôle exige un solide leadership interfonctionnel et externe des partenaires, la gestion de l'équipe d'ingénierie et la gestion des intervenants.

Responsabilités

• Diriger l'équipe d'ingénierie des matériels pour le développement de produits combinés médicament-dispositifs dans l'ensemble des biens assignés, coordonner les intrants interfonctionnels de l'ingénierie des matériels, des facteurs humains, de la qualité, de la réglementation, de la clinique/médicale, de l'approvisionnement, de la fabrication/des opérations techniques, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, du commerce et des partenaires externes.

• Accompagner et mentorer les membres de l'équipe d'ingénierie des appareils, développer des compétences techniques et de leadership.

• Diriger et coordonner les activités de sélection et de mise au point d'appareils appropriées à l'étape du développement, y compris les intrants, les extrants, la planification de la vérification et de la validation, la qualification des fournisseurs, la stratégie d'essai, l'état de préparation de la documentation et l'appui à la présentation réglementaire. Posséder et maintenir le dossier d'historique de conception (DHF), s'assurer que la documentation est complète, exacte, prête à l'inspection et conforme au système de qualité de la LSC et aux cadres réglementaires applicables aux produits combinés.

• Traduire les besoins des utilisateurs et la stratégie de programme en exigences de produits, plans de développement, jalons, risques et livrables. Assurer l'alignement entre la conception de l'appareil, l'emballage primaire, l'emballage secondaire, les facteurs humains et la stratégie globale de CMC/produit.

• Diriger les activités de gestion des risques, y compris l'analyse des risques, l'évaluation des risques et la planification de l'atténuation. Planifier et mettre en oeuvre une stratégie de contrôle des produits combinés dans l'ensemble de l'approvisionnement, conformément à CMC. Soutenir les facteurs humains et les activités d'utilisation pour s'assurer que l'interface utilisateur, le matériel didactique et les considérations liées à l'utilisation prévue correspondent aux besoins des patients et aux attentes réglementaires. Établir et diriger des pratiques exemplaires au sein du DDSP pour le génie des appareils, y compris des approches normalisées pour l'évaluation des risques de conception, l'évaluation biologique et d'autres produits livrables clés.

• Représenter l'équipe d'ingénierie des appareils au sein des équipes de programme interfonctionnelles et s'assurer que les produits livrables combinés correspondent aux besoins du programme. Créer, gérer et exécuter des plans de travail intégrés, des échéanciers, des registres des décisions, des dates de réunion, des registres des risques et des voies d'escalade. Établir des partenariats avec les chefs de projet et les équipes de développement afin d'assurer des priorités claires, l'exécution en temps opportun et la résolution efficace des risques et des dépendances.

• Établir et maintenir des relations de travail solides avec les fournisseurs, les fournisseurs, les OEM, les laboratoires d'essais, les OCM et d'autres partenaires externes afin de permettre le développement, la qualification et les activités de soutien à la soumission. Appuyer la stratégie d'approvisionnement, la diligence raisonnable et les évaluations du développement des entreprises liées aux produits combinés dans le cadre de l'expertise technique.

• Mettre en oeuvre et approuver des capacités de bout en bout pour le développement de combinaisons médicaments-dispositifs dans le cadre du développement de produits pharmaceutiques, y compris des livres de lecture, des modèles, des pratiques exemplaires et des approches de partage des connaissances. Favoriser l'innovation par le dépistage et l'évaluation de la technologie, en identifiant les possibilités d'améliorer l'expérience du patient, la fabrication, la robustesse et la flexibilité du cycle de vie. Représenter les intérêts de CSL dans les forums de l'industrie tels que les TC ISO et BioPhorum ainsi que partager l'information des forums de l'industrie à ses collègues.

• Suivi au niveau du programme des échéanciers, des risques, des décisions et des produits livrables afin de communiquer clairement les progrès réalisés. Mentor Device Engineers, promouvoir la cohérence entre les programmes,

jobs.title: Nonclinical Study Coordinator – 4 Months (Maternity Replacement)

titleByLocale.fr: Nonclinical Study Coordinateur – 4 Months (Maternity Replacement)

jobs.description:
We are looking for a highly organized, task-oriented Study & Vendor Support Coordinator to support the operational management of outsourced nonclinical studies and development programs. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys creating structure from complex information, building and maintaining digital systems, and helping functional teams stay aligned.

A scientific background and hands-on experience in an animal laboratory are essential to understand the context of this role and the urgency behind specific nonclinical deliverables.

This position focuses on nonclinical operations, meeting coordination, documentation management, and vendor support. You will work closely with the senior study manager, study monitors, business development representatives from vendors, and functional leads. A central responsibility of this role is to take over administrative and coordination tasks from study monitors and functional leads so they can focus on scientific and strategic activities. The ideal candidate is warm, dependable, and enjoys creating efficient, well-organized processes.

Responsibilities:
Operations & Study Support

• Manage the operational flow: contract sourcing review → legal/functional review → execution → PO creation in SAP → vendor notification → SAP invoice approval → consolidation of all documents in customized MS-office tools.

• Maintain strict & complete documentation. Support day-to-day coordination of external nonclinical studies and help improve overall timelines from study ideation to completion.

• Consolidate study information, keep timelines and documents consistently updated.

• Organize and coordinate global meetings, including vendor service selection and alignment calls.

• Proactively reduce administrative workload for study monitors and functional leads.

Vendor & Contract Coordination

• Collect vendor service proposals, prepare bid-score and budget comparisons.

• Support contract routing, version tracking, and information gathering of proposals.

• Communicate with external vendors, including discussions in German when needed .

• Consolidate external vendor qualification and service information in SharePoint.

• Create and maintain external vendor supplier accounts in SAP.

• Support third-party risk management activities.

Digital Tools & Workflow Management
· Use tools such as Microsoft SharePoint, MS-Excel dashboards, Power BI, and Customized templates to improve information visibility and workflow efficiency. Reinforce compliance when required.
· Contribute to small process improvements in documentation, communication, and operational workflows.

Administrative & Meeting Support

• Schedule global meetings, prepare agendas, and document action items.

• Track study milestones, deadlines, and follow-up activities.

• Maintain internal trackers and ensure clear, organized communication across teams.

Scope and Flexibility

• Above describes core expectations for the role; however, responsibilities may be tailored based on the candidate’s specific strengths and the evolving needs of the team, provided they align with our functional remit.

Profile requirements
Education

• Bachelor’s degree in a Scientific field (e.g., Life Sciences, Biology, Chemistry).

• Research experience (esp. laboratory animal work, bachelor thesis in pharmacology/toxicology, or scientific internship in research lab ).

Experience:

• Strong administrative and task-oriented mindset is highly required.

• Experience in clinical or nonclinical study management is a plus but not required.

• Experience working in nonclinical contract research organization is a plus but not required.

• Experience in project management is desired

• Experience with SAP will be of advantage but not required.

• Well-suited for academic researchers transitioning into scientific study management.

Competencies

• Strong affinity for operations, structured processes, and task-driven work.

• Ability to influence stakeholders and support complian

descriptionByLocale.it:
Siamo alla ricerca di un coordinatore di supporto per lo studio e il fornitore altamente organizzato e orientato al compito per supportare la gestione operativa di studi e programmi di sviluppo non clinici esterni. Questo ruolo è ideale per chi ama la creazione di strutture da informazioni complesse, la costruzione e il mantenimento di sistemi digitali, e aiutare i team funzionali rimanere allineati.

Un background scientifico e un'esperienza pratica in un laboratorio animale sono essenziali per comprendere il contesto di questo ruolo e l'urgenza dietro specifici materiali non clinici.

Questa posizione si concentra sulle operazioni non cliniche, sul coordinamento delle riunioni, sulla gestione della documentazione e sul supporto dei fornitori. Potrai lavorare a stretto contatto con il senior study manager, monitor di studio, rappresentanti di sviluppo aziendale da fornitori e lead funzionali. Una responsabilità centrale di questo ruolo è quella di assumere compiti amministrativi e di coordinamento da monitor di studio e lead funzionali in modo da poter concentrarsi sulle attività scientifiche e strategiche. Il candidato ideale è caldo, affidabile e gode di creare processi efficienti e ben organizzati.

Responsabilità:
Operazioni e supporto di studio

• Gestire il flusso operativo: revisione dei contratti → revisione legale/funzionale → esecuzione → creazione PO in SAP → notifica dei fornitori → approvazione della fattura SAP → consolidamento di tutti i documenti in strumenti di MS-office personalizzati.

• Mantenere la documentazione rigorosa e completa. Sostenere il coordinamento quotidiano di studi non clinici esterni e contribuire a migliorare le linee temporali globali dall'ideazione di studio al completamento.

• Consolidare le informazioni di studio, mantenere le linee temporali e i documenti costantemente aggiornati.

• Organizzare e coordinare incontri globali, tra cui la selezione dei servizi di vendita e le chiamate di allineamento.

• Proattivamente ridurre il carico di lavoro amministrativo per monitor di studio e cavi funzionali.

Fornitore e coordinamento dei contratti

• Raccogliere le proposte di servizio del fornitore, preparare i confronti di offerta-score e budget.

• Supporto contratto routing, monitoraggio delle versioni e raccolta di informazioni di proposte.

• Comunicare con fornitori esterni, comprese le discussioni in tedesco quando necessario.

• Consolidare le qualifiche e le informazioni di servizio del fornitore esterno in SharePoint.

• Creare e mantenere account fornitori esterni in SAP.

• Sostenere le attività di gestione del rischio di terze parti.

Strumenti digitali e gestione del flusso di lavoro
· Utilizzare strumenti come Microsoft SharePoint, dashboard MS-Excel, Power BI e modelli personalizzati per migliorare la visibilità delle informazioni e l'efficienza del flusso di lavoro. Rinforzare la conformità quando necessario.
· Contribuire a piccoli miglioramenti di processo nella documentazione, nella comunicazione e nei flussi di lavoro operativi.

Supporto amministrativo e di riunione

• Pianificare le riunioni globali, preparare gli ordini del giorno e documenti di azione.

• Traccia le tappe dello studio, le scadenze e le attività di follow-up.

• Mantenere i tracker interni e garantire una comunicazione chiara e organizzata tra le squadre.

Ambito e flessibilità

• Sopra descrive le principali aspettative per il ruolo; tuttavia, le responsabilità possono essere adattate in base ai punti di forza specifici del candidato e alle esigenze in evoluzione del team, a condizione che si allineano con il nostro impegno funzionale.

Requisiti di profilo
Istruzione

• Laurea in campo scientifico (ad esempio, Scienze della vita, Biologia, Chimica).

• Esperienza di ricerca (esp. lavoro animale di laboratorio, tesi di laurea in farmacologia / tossicologia, o stage scientifico in laboratorio di ricerca ).

Esperienza:

• Forte mentalità amministrativa e orientata al compito è altamente richiesto.

• L'esperienza nella gestione di studi clinici o non clinici è un plus ma non richiesto.

• L'esperienza di lavoro nell'organizzazione di ricerca di contratti non clinici è un plus ma non richiesto.

• L'esperienza nella gestione del progetto è desiderata

• L'esperienza con SAP sarà di grande vantaggio ma non è necessaria.

• Ben adatto per i ricercatori accademici che passano nella gestione dello studio scientifico.

Competenze

• Forte affinità per operazioni, processi strutturati e lavoro azionato.

• Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder e il supporto compiacente

descriptionByLocale.de:
Wir suchen einen hoch organisierten, aufgabenorientierten Study & Vendor Support Coordinator, der das operative Management von ausgelagerten nichtklinischen Studien und Entwicklungsprogrammen unterstützt. Diese Rolle ist ideal für jemanden, der es genießt, Strukturen aus komplexen Informationen zu erstellen, digitale Systeme aufzubauen und zu warten und funktionalen Teams zu helfen, ausgerichtet zu bleiben.

Ein wissenschaftlicher Hintergrund und praktische Erfahrungen in einem Tierlabor sind unerlässlich, um den Kontext dieser Rolle und die Dringlichkeit bestimmter nichtklinischer Ergebnisse zu verstehen.

Diese Position konzentriert sich auf nichtklinische Operationen, Meeting-Koordination, Dokumentationsmanagement und Lieferantensupport. Sie werden eng mit dem leitenden Studienleiter, Studienmonitoren, Vertretern der Geschäftsentwicklung von Anbietern und funktionalen Leads zusammenarbeiten. Eine zentrale Aufgabe dieser Rolle ist es, Verwaltungs- und Koordinationsaufgaben von Studienmonitoren und funktionellen Leitern zu übernehmen, damit sie sich auf wissenschaftliche und strategische Aktivitäten konzentrieren können. Der ideale Kandidat ist warm, zuverlässig und genießt es, effiziente, gut organisierte Prozesse zu schaffen.

Zuständigkeiten:
Operations & Study Support

• Verwalten Sie den operativen Ablauf: Contract Sourcing Review → Legal/Functional Review → Execution → PO Creation in SAP → Vendor Notification → SAP bill approval → Konsolidierung aller Dokumente in maßgeschneiderten MS-Office Tools.

• Pflegen Sie strenge und vollständige Dokumentation. Unterstützung der täglichen Koordination externer nichtklinischer Studien und Verbesserung der Gesamtzeitpläne von der Studienidee bis zum Abschluss.

• Konsolidieren Sie die Studieninformationen, halten Sie Zeitpläne und Dokumente konsistent aktualisiert.

• Organisieren und koordinieren Sie globale Meetings, einschließlich der Auswahl von Anbieterservices und Abstimmungsaufrufen.

• Reduzieren Sie proaktiv den administrativen Arbeitsaufwand für Studienmonitore und funktionale Leads.

Vendor & Contract Koordination

• Sammeln Sie Anbieter-Service-Vorschläge, bereiten Sie Bid-Score- und Budget-Vergleiche vor.

• Unterstützen Sie das Vertragsrouting, die Versionsverfolgung und die Sammlung von Vorschlägen.

• Kommunizieren Sie mit externen Anbietern, einschließlich Diskussionen auf Deutsch, wenn nötig.

• Konsolidieren Sie externe Anbieterqualifikations- und Serviceinformationen in SharePoint.

• Erstellen und pflegen Sie externe Lieferantenkonten in SAP.

• Unterstützung von Risikomanagementaktivitäten von Drittanbietern.

Digitale Tools & Workflow Management
Verwenden Sie Tools wie Microsoft SharePoint, MS-Excel Dashboards, Power BI und kundenspezifische Vorlagen, um die Transparenz der Informationen und die Workflow-Effizienz zu verbessern. Verstärkte Einhaltung, wenn erforderlich.
· Beitrag zu kleinen Prozessverbesserungen in Dokumentation, Kommunikation und operativen Workflows.

Administrative & Meeting Support

• Planen Sie globale Meetings, bereiten Sie Tagesordnungen vor und dokumentieren Sie Aktionspunkte.

• Verfolgen Sie Meilensteine, Fristen und Folgeaktivitäten der Studie.

• Pflegen Sie interne Tracker und sorgen Sie für eine klare, organisierte Kommunikation zwischen den Teams.

Anwendungsbereich und Flexibilität

• Oben werden die Kernerwartungen für die Rolle beschrieben; die Verantwortlichkeiten können jedoch auf der Grundlage der spezifischen Stärken des Kandidaten und der sich entwickelnden Bedürfnisse des Teams zugeschnitten werden, sofern sie mit unserem funktionalen Aufgabenbereich übereinstimmen.

Anforderungen an das Profil
Bildung

• Bachelor-Abschluss in einem wissenschaftlichen Bereich (z. B. Life Sciences, Biologie, Chemie).

• Forschungserfahrung (z. B. Labortierarbeit, Bachelorarbeit in Pharmakologie / Toxikologie oder wissenschaftliches Praktikum im Forschungslabor).

Erfahrung:

• Eine starke administrative und aufgabenorientierte Denkweise ist dringend erforderlich.

• Erfahrung im klinischen oder nichtklinischen Studienmanagement ist ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich.

• Erfahrung in nicht-klinischen Auftragsforschung Organisation ist ein Plus, aber nicht erforderlich.

• Erfahrung im Projektmanagement ist erwünscht

• Erfahrung mit SAP wird von Vorteil sein, aber nicht erforderlich.

• Gut geeignet für akademische Forscher, die in das wissenschaftliche Studienmanagement übergehen.

Kompetenzen

• Starke Affinität zu Operationen, strukturierten Prozessen und aufgabengesteuerter Arbeit.

• Fähigkeit, Stakeholder zu beeinflussen und Complian zu unterstützen
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes à la recherche d'un coordonnateur d'étude et de soutien des fournisseurs hautement organisé et axé sur les tâches pour appuyer la gestion opérationnelle des études non cliniques et des programmes de développement externalisés. Ce rôle est idéal pour quelqu'un qui aime créer une structure à partir d'informations complexes, construire et maintenir des systèmes numériques, et aider les équipes fonctionnelles à rester alignées.

Un contexte scientifique et une expérience pratique dans un laboratoire d'animaux sont essentiels pour comprendre le contexte de ce rôle et l'urgence de certains produits non cliniques.

Ce poste est axé sur les opérations non cliniques, la coordination des réunions, la gestion de la documentation et le soutien des fournisseurs. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec le directeur principal de l'étude, les moniteurs d'étude, les représentants du développement des affaires des fournisseurs et les responsables fonctionnels. Une responsabilité centrale de ce rôle est de prendre en charge les tâches administratives et de coordination des moniteurs d'études et des responsables fonctionnels afin qu'ils puissent se concentrer sur les activités scientifiques et stratégiques. Le candidat idéal est chaleureux, fiable et aime créer des processus efficaces et bien organisés.

Responsabilités :
Opérations et soutien aux études

• Gérer le flux opérationnel : examen du sourcing des contrats → revue juridique/fonctionnelle → exécution → création de PO dans SAP → notification du fournisseur → approbation de facture SAP → consolidation de tous les documents dans des outils MS-office personnalisés.

• Maintenir une documentation stricte et complète. Appuyer la coordination quotidienne des études non cliniques externes et aider à améliorer le calendrier global de l'idée d'étude jusqu'à l'achèvement.

• Consolider l'information sur l'étude, tenir à jour les échéanciers et les documents.

• Organiser et coordonner des réunions mondiales, y compris la sélection des fournisseurs et les appels d'alignement.

• Réduire proactivement la charge de travail administrative des moniteurs d'études et des responsables fonctionnels.

Coordination des fournisseurs et des contrats

• Recueillir les propositions de services aux fournisseurs, établir des comparaisons entre les soumissions et les budgets.

• Soutenir l'acheminement des contrats, le suivi des versions et la collecte d'information sur les propositions.

• Communiquer avec les fournisseurs externes, y compris les discussions en allemand au besoin.

• Consolider les informations sur la qualification et le service des fournisseurs externes dans SharePoint.

• Créer et maintenir des comptes fournisseurs externes dans SAP.

• Appuyer les activités de gestion des risques par des tiers.

Outils numériques et gestion des flux de travail
· Utilisez des outils tels que Microsoft SharePoint, les tableaux de bord MS-Excel, Power BI et des modèles personnalisés pour améliorer la visibilité de l'information et l'efficacité du workflow. Renforcer la conformité au besoin.
· Contribuer aux petites améliorations des processus dans la documentation, la communication et les workflows opérationnels.

Soutien administratif & réunions

• Planifier les réunions mondiales, préparer les ordres du jour et documenter les mesures à prendre.

• Suivre les étapes de l'étude, les échéances et les activités de suivi.

• Maintenir des suivis internes et assurer une communication claire et organisée entre les équipes.

Portée et souplesse

• Nous décrivons ci-dessus les principales attentes à l'égard du rôle, mais les responsabilités peuvent être adaptées en fonction des forces spécifiques du candidat et de l'évolution des besoins de l'équipe, à condition qu'elles correspondent à notre mandat fonctionnel.

Exigences relatives au profil
Éducation

• Baccalauréat dans un domaine scientifique (p. ex. sciences de la vie, biologie, chimie).

• Expérience de recherche (prés. travail animal de laboratoire, thèse de baccalauréat en pharmacologie/toxicologie, ou stage scientifique en laboratoire de recherche).

Expérience :

• Une bonne attitude administrative et axée sur les tâches est très nécessaire.

• L'expérience de la gestion des études cliniques ou non cliniques est un atout mais non nécessaire.

• L'expérience de travail au sein d'un organisme de recherche à contrat non clinique est un plus, mais pas nécessaire.

• Une expérience de la gestion de projet est souhaitée

• L'expérience acquise avec SAP sera avantageuse mais non nécessaire.

• Bien adapté pour les chercheurs universitaires en transition vers la gestion des études scientifiques.

Compétences

• Une forte affinité pour les opérations, les processus structurés et le travail axé sur les tâches.

• Capacité d'influencer les parties prenantes et de soutenir la réalisation

jobs.description:
Associate Director, Brand Marketing (m/f/x) – Haematology
Fulltime / Permanent
Location: Germany (Munich OR Frankfurt area), United Kingdom (Maidenhead OR Haywards Heath), Spain (Barcelona)

The Opportunity

As Associate Director, Brand Marketing (Haematology) you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the brand and disease area strategy for the International (INT) region. You will drive market expansion, strengthen brand adoption, and ensure strategic alignment across diverse markets - while enabling affiliates to meet local needs and regulatory environments.
In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross ‑ functional teams, affiliates, International Marketing (Int Mkt), and Global Commercial Development (GCD).

You will lead the development of fit ‑ for ‑ purpose go ‑ to ‑ market strategies, integrated marketing programs, lifecycle management initiatives, and brand playbooks that support consistent, high ‑ quality execution across the region.

The Role:

• Drive the development of brand and disease area strategies for the INT region, aligned with corporate and portfolio goals.

• Act as the primary marketing partner for affiliates, fostering a strong, collaborative international marketing community.

• Develop integrated, insight-driven brand strategies tailored to diverse markets.

• Map and prioritize archetypes, ensuring targeted positioning and messaging.

• Identify short- and long-term opportunities, challenges, and lifecycle management initiatives.

• Lead market analysis to inform strategic decisions and optimize plans.

• Build aligned, customer-focused brand plans and ensure disciplined regional implementation.

• Define KPIs and monitor performance, adjusting activities based on data and insights.

• Lead the 3M Brand Team and ensure clear agendas, actions, and follow-through.

• Serve as central contact for internal and external stakeholders across Marketing, Medical, Regulatory, Finance, and KOL/HCP networks.

• Manage the regional brand budget to maximize ROI.

Your Skills and Experience:

Education:

• Graduate degree or equivalent required.

• Postgraduate qualification preferred.

Experience:

• 8–10 years of healthcare experience with 7+ years in pharmaceutical or biotech brand sales and marketing.

• Proven track record of driving brand strategy with operational excellence and delivering above ‑ market results.

• Experience leading above ‑ country marketing initiatives and influencing diverse, multicultural matrix teams.

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate insights into actionable strategies and tactics.

• Proficiency in CRM systems and data ‑ driven marketing tools.

• Excellent project management skills with experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.

• Excellent command of English (spoken and written).

Reporting Relationships:
Reports to: Senior Director, Marketing Portfolio Lead Haematology, Commercial Operations International

What We Offer
At CSL, we are committed to supporting our employees in their personal and professional growth. You can expect:

• Meaningful work with impact on patients around the world.

• A dynamic, international environment with cross-functional collaboration and global exposure.

• Attractive compensation & benefits package, including competitive salary, bonus programs, and comprehensive benefits (country-specific).

• Flexible and hybrid working models that support work–life balance.

• Professional development opportunities, including global learning resources, leadership development, and mobility programs.

• Inclusive culture that values diversity, integrity, and innovation.

• A purpose-driven organization where you can contribute to improving patients’ lives every day.

#LI-MW1

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for peop

descriptionByLocale.it:
Direttore associato, Brand Marketing (m/f/x) – Haematology
A tempo pieno / permanente
Ubicazione: Germania (zona Monaco o Francoforte), Regno Unito (Maidenhead O Haywards Heath), Spagna (Barcellona)

L'opportunità

Come Direttore associato, Brand Marketing (Haematology) si svolgerà un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione e nell'esecuzione della strategia di area del marchio e della malattia per la regione internazionale (INT). Potrai guidare l'espansione del mercato, rafforzare l'adozione del marchio e garantire l'allineamento strategico su diversi mercati - consentendo agli affiliati di soddisfare le esigenze locali e gli ambienti normativi.
In questo ruolo, collaborerai a stretto contatto con team funzionali, affiliati, Marketing Internazionale (Int Mkt), e Global Commercial Development (GCD).

Potrai condurre lo sviluppo di fit ‐ per ‐ scopo andare a ‐ strategie di mercato, programmi di marketing integrati, iniziative di gestione del ciclo di vita e giochi di marca che supportano l'esecuzione coerente e di alta qualità in tutta la regione.

Il ruolo:

• Guidare lo sviluppo di strategie di marca e area malattia per la regione INT, allineati con obiettivi aziendali e portafoglio.

• Agire come partner di marketing primario per le affiliate, promuovendo una forte e collaborativa comunità di marketing internazionale.

• Sviluppare strategie di marca integrate e orientate alle informazioni su misura per mercati diversi.

• Mappa e priorità archetipi, garantendo posizionamento mirato e messaggistica.

• Identificare opportunità, sfide e iniziative di gestione del ciclo di vita a breve e lungo termine.

• Analisi del mercato di piombo per informare le decisioni strategiche e ottimizzare i piani.

• Costruire piani di marca orientati al cliente e garantire l'implementazione regionale disciplinata.

• Definire i KPI e monitorare le prestazioni, regolare le attività in base ai dati e alle informazioni.

• Guidare il team di marca 3M e garantire chiare agenda, azioni e follow-through.

• Servire come contatto centrale per gli stakeholder interni ed esterni attraverso le reti Marketing, Medico, Regolatore, Finanza e KOL/HCP.

• Gestire il budget del marchio regionale per massimizzare ROI.

Le tue abilità ed esperienza:

Istruzione:

• Laurea o equivalente richiesto.

• Titolo post-laurea preferito.

Esperienza:

• 8-10 anni di esperienza sanitaria con 7+ anni di vendita e commercializzazione del marchio farmaceutico o biotecnologico.

• Rilevato record di strategia del marchio di guida con l'eccellenza operativa e la fornitura di risultati superiori al mercato.

• Esperienza leader delle iniziative di marketing del paese e l'influenza di diverse squadre di matrice multiculturale.

• Forte capacità analitiche e la capacità di tradurre intuizioni in strategie e tattiche attuabili.

• La competenza nei sistemi CRM e negli strumenti di marketing basati sui dati.

• Eccellente capacitÃ di gestione del progetto con esperienza leader complessi, iniziative multi-stakeholder.

• Ottimo comando dell'inglese (spoken e scritto).

Rapporti:
Rapporti a: Senior Director, Marketing Portfolio Lead Haematology, Operazioni Commerciali Internazionale

Cosa offriamo
A CSL, ci impegniamo a sostenere i nostri dipendenti nella loro crescita personale e professionale. Ci si può aspettare:

• Lavoro significativo con impatto sui pazienti di tutto il mondo.

• Ambiente dinamico e internazionale con collaborazione interfunzionale e esposizione globale.

• Pacchetto di compensazione attraente e benefici, tra cui stipendio competitivo, programmi bonus e benefici completi (specifico paese).

• Modelli di lavoro flessibili e ibridi che supportano l'equilibrio tra lavoro e vita.

• Opportunità di sviluppo professionale, comprese le risorse di apprendimento globali, lo sviluppo della leadership e i programmi di mobilità.

• Cultura inclusiva che valorizza la diversità, l'integrità e l'innovazione.

• Un'organizzazione mirata in cui si può contribuire a migliorare la vita dei pazienti ogni giorno.

#LI-MW1 #

Informazioni su CSL Behring
CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per la peop
